**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID:** R040204 **Date posted:** 10/22/2026

**Senior Manager, Office of the CEO**

The Senior Manager, Office of the CEO serves as the CEO’s senior executive support partner, with primary responsibility for maximizing the CEO’s time, readiness, responsiveness, and effectiveness. As an integral member of the Office of the CEO, this role also provides administrative and operational support to the Chief of Staff and contributes to the effective execution of broader Office of the CEO priorities, including Executive Committee and Board activities. Exercising exceptional judgment and discretion, the Senior Manager oversees complex calendars, travel, meeting preparation, commitments, and day-to-day information flow while partnering across the Office to anticipate needs, coordinate priorities, and ensure seamless execution. This is primarily a remote position; however, regular travel and residence within commuting distance of a Jazz U.S. office are required to support in-person business needs. This reports to the CEO.

**Essential Functions**

* **Strategic Calendaring:** Manage the CEO’s schedule efficiently and strategically, ing critical thinking to protect time for shifting priorities and meeting preparation, including external board obligations. Schedule Executive Committee meetings (weekly, monthly, and quarterly), Board meetings, and Board committee meetings.
* **CEO Meeting Readiness:** Anticipate and coordinate all aspects of meeting preparation, including clarifying objectives, protecting meeting preparation time, confirming logistics, and partnering with the Chief of Staff to secure pre-reads and briefing materials, ensuring the CEO is fully prepared for every meeting and engagement.
* **Executive Communications and Follow-Through:** Triage requests and correspondence directed to the CEO, identify matters requiring immediate attention, coordinate timely responses with appropriate partners, and record the CEO’s commitments and follow-up actions in the team’s tracking system (Microsoft To Do).
* **Coordination:** Coordinate with designated contacts to ensure relevant business travel and commitments are reflected across the CEO’s calendars and, on occasion, assist with scheduling adjustments necessitated by changing business priorities.
* **Global Travel Planning:** Prepare detailed itineraries and coordinate all aspects of domestic and international travel, including airfare, hotels, car services, and office or desk space at Jazz locations for the CEO and Chief of Staff. Support the Chief of Staff in identifying and coordinating meaningful in-person connections between the CEO and employees while traveling.
* **Board Meeting and Director Support:** Partner with the Director of Operations and third-party providers to support Board director travel, lodging, dinner reservations, and expense reimbursement. Coordinate meeting availability and communications with directors and their executive assistants and provide scheduling and travel support as needed.
* **Board Content:** Support the upload and organization of Board meeting materials, including managing document permissions and uploading and linking approved materials, as appropriate.
* **Expense Management:** Prepare and submit expense reports for the CEO and Chief of Staff within the 30-day period required by policy. Follow up with the CEO’s direct reports regarding aging, unsubmitted transactions.
* **Procurement Management:** Manage the end-to-end process for relevant purchase requisitions, purchase orders, statements of work, check requests, and invoice submission and approval for the Office of the CEO.
* **Organizational Maintenance:** Maintain organizational charts, email distribution lists, and other team resources for the Office of the CEO.
* **Collaboration:** Partner closely with the Chief of Staff and Director of Operations, as well as administrative and Global Workplace professionals across sites and time zones, to provide consistent global support for Executive Committee meetings and other Office of the CEO priorities.
* **Team Management:** Maintain and actively use team organization and workflow tools, including OneNote and Microsoft To Do.
* **Travel Expectations:** Travel to up to six meetings per year, potentially including international travel, to support the CEO and the broader Office of the CEO.
* **Team Support:** Provide backup support to other members of the Office of the CEO, as needed.

**Qualities for Success:**

* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of commitments and outcomes, follows through reliably, and promptly addresses or escalates issues.
* **Attention to Detail:** Maintains exceptional accuracy and organization, ensuring that details, materials, and logistics are complete and reliable.
* **Critical Thinking:** Evaluates requests, circumstances, and trade-offs thoughtfully; makes sound decisions independently and recognizes when guidance or escalation is needed.
* **Responsiveness:** Operates with urgency in a fast-paced CEO office environment and responds quickly and thoughtfully to prioritize, act on, or escalate time-sensitive matters.
* **Creativity:** Develops practical, creative approaches to challenges and improves how work is planned and executed, whether working independently or collaboratively.
* **Proactivity and Autonomy:** Anticipates needs, stays several steps ahead, and uses available networks and resources to act independently. Identifies more efficient and effective ways for the CEO and Office of the CEO to operate.
* **Enterprise Mindset and Business Acumen:** Demonstrates curiosity about the business, asks thoughtful questions to build context, and understands how priorities, decisions, and relationships connect across the organization. Applies that understanding to anticipate needs, engage the right stakeholders, and support the CEO effectively.
* **Company Stewardship:** Treats every individual with kindness, respect, and professionalism, regardless of role or level. Represents the Office of the CEO with humility and consistent alignment to Jazz values, using the access and influence associated with the role responsibly.
* **Discretion:** Maintains confidentiality and exercises discretion in all interactions, communications, and decisions.
* **Growth Mindset:** Seeks feedback, embraces new approaches, and continuously learns and develops to increase effectiveness in the role.
* **Confidence to Constructively Challenge:** Raises concerns and constructively challenges peers and senior leaders when needed to protect the CEO’s time and improve the effectiveness of the office.
* **Prioritization:** Distinguishes the most important and time-sensitive matters, manages competing demands, and continually seeks to protect and create time for the CEO’s highest-value priorities.

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in a C-suite or senior-level administrative role supporting one or more senior executives.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment; experience in a biotechnology or pharmaceutical company is preferred.
* Experience working in an international organization.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks, work effectively with little or no direction, and build collaborative relationships with leaders, partners, and peers.
* Self-starter who is resourceful, leverages networks, proactively seeks information, and solves problems effectively.
* Ability to work, collaborate, and communicate effectively in remote and hybrid environments.
* Ability to provide flexible support across global time zones and, when business needs require, outside standard working hours.
* Effective written and oral communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and facilitation skills, with the ability to interact with Board members and executives with ease.
* Strong self-awareness and commitment to ongoing development to increase autonomy and proactivity in the role.
* Ability to work in a highly energetic, flexible, and fast-paced environment.
* Project management skills or certification preferred.

**Preferred Education and Licenses**

* College degree strongly preferred.
* Proven proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, OneNote, PowerPoint, and Zoom
* Living within commuting distance of a Jazz U.S. office: Philadelphia, PA; Carlsbad, CA; or Palo Alto, CA is required and being able to work onsite as business needs require.

**Total Rewards**
-----------------

* ### **Caring for your mind.**

  We offer a market-leading Employee Assistance Program (EAP) to give employees and their families expert guidance and specialist support on any issue, including 25 counseling sessions per year to support their mental and emotional wellbeing.
    
    
  We also offer access to a variety of online classes, meditations and webinars, on-site wellbeing activities, and challenges to help our employees feel their best.
* ### **Caring for your finances.**

  To support each employee’s diverse needs, the Jazz Wellbeing Reimbursement Account is designed to provide employees with the flexibility to decide the products and services that best support their wellbeing, empowering them to choose what is most important to them.
* ### **Caring for your Work and Life.**

  Thriving at work means successfully managing and enjoying your life outside of it. At Jazz, we make space for you to recharge with generous paid time off, including Global Paid Child Bonding Leave for all new parents and Global Paid Caregiver Leave to support loved ones.

  + Global Paid Child Bonding Leave, which is available to all new parents irrespective of gender or how they are welcoming their child to their family.
  + Global Paid Caregiver Leave is available to care for a family member with a serious health condition.
* ### **Caring for your body.**

  To support physical health, we provide tools designed to keep you active and healthy wherever you are including free access to hundreds virtual classes, as well as specialized resources to support employees through every stage of life.
* ### **Flexibility and Balance.**

  At Jazz, we are proud to offer an innovative and flexible work model developed directly from employee feedback - that best serves our people and our business. Internally known as “Jazz Remix,” our norms enable teams to decide when and where they work best, adhering to principles that balance the needs of patients and personal productivity, flexibility, and wellbeing. Regularly scheduled site connection days and in-person team gatherings allow our people to maintain a genuine sense of community and connection with each other. The Jazz Remix model does not to all roles; to learn more speak with a Recruiter.

9691b0bb3b127b5acdfc.title: Lead Senior QA Coder
9691b0bb3b127b5acdfc.description:
* Lead execution of the Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP) across intake, abstraction, and appeals support functions, ensuring the program sustains CMS's mandated 95% accuracy rate and inter-rater reliability (IRR) standard.
* Design, implement, and continuously refine the quality control sampling methodology used to audit Mid-Level and Senior Coder determinations.
* Conduct or oversee secondary review and audit of coding determinations to identify nonconformance, discrepancy patterns, or systemic coding inconsistency.
* Apply deep, independent coding expertise to evaluate the accuracy and consistency of coding determinations across the full coding team, exercising final internal quality judgment on contested or borderline cases.
* Analyze error trends across intake, abstraction, and appeals to identify root causes and recommend corrective and continuous improvement actions.
* Compile and deliver the QA summary and supporting metrics included in the Monthly Status and Cost Report, along with coder productivity data, for submission to CMS by the 20th of each month.
* Coordinate with CMS and the RADV Independent Coding Consultant (ICC) on training needs, scheduling, and content based on observed quality trends.
* Escalate significant coding disagreements, quality risks, or compliance concerns to the Program Director and, where necessary, directly to CMS when internal resolution pathways are insufficient.
* Contribute QA-driven findings and recommendations to CDAT-M workflow and reporting improvement efforts.
* Ensure quality control documentation, sampling records, and audit trails are maintained and audit-ready at all times in accordance with CMS data governance and confidentiality requirements.
* Support the Program Director in developing and maintaining the QASP required within 10 business days of contract award.

* **Must complete assessment:** Medical Coding Assessment
* Active, valid coding certification from AHIMA or AAPC, one of the following: Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Outpatient Coder (COC), Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC), Certified Risk Adjustment Coder (CRC), Certified Coding Associate (CCA), or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS).
* Extensive professional coding experience (typically 7 or more years), including demonstrated experience in a formal quality assurance, coding audit, or coding oversight capacity.
* Demonstrated expertise in ICD-9-CM and ICD-10-CM coding guidelines and CMS-HCC risk adjustment methodology.
* Proven track record designing or administering quality control programs, inter-rater reliability processes, or coding audit methodologies, ideally within a federal or large-scale healthcare payer environment.
* Strong analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to identify error trends and translate findings into actionable process or training improvements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing quality reporting for government or executive stakeholders.
* Ability to pass a federal background investigation and obtain the position-appropriate personnel security clearance/credential required for CMS system access (PIV or equivalent).
* Comfortable working in a fully remote, virtual-meeting environment using standard CMS-approved collaboration and secure data-exchange tools.
* Must be a U.S. citizen or otherwise authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship, and reside within the United States (work outside the U.S. and its territories is prohibited under this contract absent prior written government approval).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience with CMS Risk Adjustment programs, RADV, HCC coding, or Medicare Advantage payment methodology, ideally in a quality assurance or compliance-facing role.
* Experience with CDAT-M or similar federal medical record review platforms.
* Experience supporting or leading a QASP under a federal services contract.
* Familiarity with CPARS reporting standards and CMS Center for Program Integrity expectations.

4afc6c9dba31326a8b1a.description:
Talcott Financial Group\* is an international life insurance company committed to providing comprehensive risk solutions to its customers. Whether it’s providing peace of mind for policyholders approaching retirement, or helping insurers solve complex risk and capital challenges, Talcott delivers practical solutions that support long-term stability for policyholders and clients.
  
  
Talcott offers the strength of an established organization with the mindset and approach of a modern platform. The enterprise is supported by a proven track record of well-executed transactions, investment-grade financial strength ratings, and strong financial position, with over $136 billion in assets under management. Talcott also benefits from a strategic partnership with Sixth Street, a leading global investment firm managing over $135 billion in assets.
  
  
Talcott’s approach to business is disciplined, transparent, and multi-channel, spanning retail annuities, block and flow reinsurance, and legal entity acquisitions. We have offices in Bermuda, the Cayman Islands, Connecticut, New York, and North Carolina.
  
  
**Overview:**  
This position will be a key member of the Operations team responsible for supporting Talcott’s retail infrastructure. Our Quality Analyst role will support our thriving retail annuity business model where we have established a strong technical infrastructure, distribution relationships, and a dynamic work environment where you make a difference every day supporting our customers!
  
The selected Quality Analyst will play a key role in monitoring and evaluating the accuracy of Talcott’s customer service interactions. Additional quality reviews may include oversight of financial processing transactions to align with internal control standards. This pivotal position will ensure that we deliver superior customer service to our valued customers, contract owners and financial advisors. Additionally, the Quality Analyst will provide suggestions for process improvement elements related to performance, procedures, training and/or compliance standards. The ideal candidate will work in a hybrid arrangement in our Hartford, Connecticut office. Remote work will also be considered.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Administer quality programs and processes in collaboration with business partners and leaders to support superb customer service interactions
* Monitor and measure the quality, accuracy, timeliness, and procedural compliance of customer service calls
* Use AI to create training efficiencies for operational support teams
* Collaborate with multiple business segments including pre-sales, IT and retail ops leadership
* Evaluate financial transaction processing and internal controls using scorecards, sampling methods using established review standards
* Perform quality reviews and peer-to-peer reviews validating transaction documentation, system entries, approvals, calculations, correspondence, and adherence to procedures
* Track, analyze, and communicate quality results to leadership
* Address error trends, recurring process gaps, root-cause themes, risk exposure, and progress against established quality goals with leadership
* Maintain quality tools, scorecards, trackers and support documentation, ensuring they remain accurate, current, consistently applied, and aligned with performance goals
* Document all audit and compliance findings including exceptions and corrective actions
* Present identified audit concerns/gaps to business partners and/or leadership as appropriate
* Recommend and implement process improvement suggestions to enhance performance workflows (i.e. procedures, controls, job aids, and training materials operational feedback and identified root causes)
* Collaborate with internal business partners, vendors, and service partners on quality processes and procedures, providing guidance, clarifying requirements, and supporting consistent execution across teams
* Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports addressing trends and control results
* Present concise, actionable information that helps managers and leaders prioritize remediation, coaching, training, and process improvements.
* Support projects, system changes, new processes, and operational initiatives by assessing control impacts thru testing and risk identification efforts
* Provide timely, constructive feedback and coaching to employees based on quality results, clearly explaining findings, required corrections, applicable procedures, and opportunities to strengthen accuracy

**Qualifications:**  

* Minimum of 3 years of customer service experience in the financial services industry
* Working knowledge of annuities or life insurance products is strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience
* Demonstrated experience navigating multiple applications and dual monitors
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* Demonstrated capacity to develop positive and productive customer relationships
* Experience supporting quality assurance, auditing, compliance, financial transaction processing, customer service operations, or related work
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess, identify trends, and translate findings into practical recommendations
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across teams and present findings to managers and/or other business partners
* Ability to work independently while managing competing priorities
* Sound judgment, attention to detail, and a commitment to accuracy in support of operational controls
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office and SharePoint
* Experience with Verint, FAST, PEGA, Surance Bay and Portals
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Access

**Compensation:**  
This range represents the minimum and maximum annual base salary we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range. The base pay is based on factors including but not limited to experience, competence, and demonstration of proficiencies essential for the role. The base pay is just one component of Talcott’s total annual compensation for employees. Other compensation may include annual bonuses, long-term incentives and recognition.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, sex, religion, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, ancestry or citizenship status, genetic information, pregnancy status or any other characteristic protected by law. af5f0ad193c0e618fec3.title: Billing Compliance and Quality Control Analyst - UW Medicine, Clinical Trials Office
af5f0ad193c0e618fec3.description:
**Job Description**

**The Clinical Trials Office has an outstanding opportunity for a Billing Compliance and Quality Control Analyst to join their team.**

  

**About this Opportunity**

  

Reporting to the Billing Compliance Operations and Quality Control Manager, the Billing Compliance and Quality Control Analyst serves as a subject matter expert in the comprehensive and independent final compliance review (Summary Review) of all documents related to research study funding, including the research study budget, protocol, contractual terms, informed consent, and other supporting documentation. Additionally, this position functions as a subject matter expert with Clinical Trials Office (CTO) production workflows and systems processes, and will offer suggestions for optimization strategies.

  

This is a 100% remote, telework position.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Workflow and Billing Compliance (40%)**

* Perform comprehensive and independent analysis of systems processes pertaining to CTO review workflows.
* Regularly update and work with the Clinical Trial Management System (OnCore), Zendesk (ZD) Customer Service Management tool, the CTO Database (CTODB), and other comprehensive electronic study documentation for each clinical research study, in compliance with UW policies, procedures and standards.
* Analyze, interpret and apply internal and external research billing policies, assisting faculty, study staff, and clinical managers in determining applicable review requirements and facilitating timely budget approval.
Understand and exercise independent judgment and discretion in the interpretation and application of the Medicare Clinical Trial Policy, and all relevant UW Medicine clinical research budgeting and billing policies and procedures.  

  

**Quality Assurance (QA)/Quality Check (QC) (60%)**

* Perform QA, identifying root cause issues and addressing queries from clients, and escalate as appropriate to the Manager and Sr. Workflow Lead.
* Perform QC of workflow pathways for proper routing of studies through the start-up process.
* Perform QC of final compliance review (Summary Review) for team members training in the workflow.
* Perform QC of the Coverage Analysis work performed by a third party or internal CTO staff. Ensure Coverage Analysts have designated study items and services as non-covered research-only or covered routine, in compliance with Medicare coverage rules.
* Perform final QC of clinical trial budgets that have been internally developed and negotiated with pharmaceutical and biotechnology corporate sponsors, contract research organizations and other sponsor institutions.
Perform data QC to ensure accuracy and alignment across multiple systems (OnCore, Epic, Zendesk, CTO Database, etc.).  

  

**Required Qualifications**

To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

A Bachelor’s degree in science, business, healthcare administration or related field and at least three years’ related experience or equivalent combination of experience and education.  

  

**Applicants who do not meet these qualifications will not be forwarded to the hiring manager.**

  

**Additional Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of the Medicare Clinical Trials Policy and other Federal, State and institutional clinical research regulations.

* Exceptional customer service skills with the ability to communicate effectively with all levels of staff, faculty, management and collaborators.
* Strong written and oral presentation skills, with demonstrated skill in using Microsoft Word, Excel, and Access.
Independently prioritize and organize work in a fast-paced, high-volume setting, in addition to ability to work effectively and efficiently in a group environment.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s Degree in business or healthcare administration or related field.
* Experience working in OnCore or other CTMS system. Experience working with an Customer Service Management (CSM) ticketing system tool, such as Zendesk.
* Familiarity with electronic medical records and healthcare business systems.
* Experience working with web-based solutions
Experience in academic health system operations or medical setting.  

**About the Team**

The Clinical Trials Office supports the clinical research mission of UW Medicine by providing multi-service operational support to research teams and helping bring important new therapies to patients in compliance with evolving regulatory requirements. As part of the School of Medicine's Office of Research and Graduate Education, the CTO partners across a broad portfolio of clinical trials to strengthen compliance, support investigators, and advance high-quality research operations.

  

If you are energized by mission-driven work, cross-functional collaboration, and the opportunity to make a measurable impact on clinical research operations, this role offers a meaningful way to contribute to patient access, sponsor confidence, and institutional excellence.

**Compensation, Benefits and Position Details**

**Pay Range Minimum:**

$84,000.00 annual

**Pay Range Maximum:**

$96,000.00 annual

**Other Compensation:**



**Benefits:**

For information about benefits for this position, visit https://www.washington.edu/jobs/benefits-for-uw-staff/

**Shift:**

First Shift (United States of America)

**Temporary or Regular?**

This is a regular position

**FTE (Full-Time Equivalent):**

100.00%

**Union/Bargaining Unit:**

Not Applicable

**About the UW**

Working at the University of Washington provides a unique opportunity to change lives – on our campuses, in our state and around the world.

UW employees bring their boundless energy, creative problem-solving skills and dedication to building stronger minds and a healthier world. In return, they enjoy outstanding benefits, opportunities for professional growth and the chance to work in an environment known for its diversity, intellectual excitement, artistic pursuits and natural beauty.

**Our Commitment**

b95e293ae5de990445fd.title: Associate Director, GCP/GCLP Quality Auditor
b95e293ae5de990445fd.description:
**About the Position**
----------------------

Reporting to the Sr. Director of Inspection Readiness and Risk Management, the Associate Director, GCP/GCLP Auditor is an integral member of the Quality and Compliance team. The GCP/GCLP Auditor is responsible for planning, scheduling and conducting GCP and GCLP quality audits on behalf of Cabaletta. This individual will also act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for GCP/GCLP auditing, quality projects and will be responsible for supporting implementation and management of the Quality Management Auditing system. The individual is responsible for independently managing internal GCP/GCLP auditing deliverables scheduled across Cabaletta.

**Responsibilities Include**
----------------------------

* **Plan and execute audits:** Develop comprehensive audit plans for GCP and GCLP activities, covering clinical sites, laboratories, CROs, and vendors supporting our cell therapy programs.
* **Conduct thorough evaluations:** Assess adherence to protocols, SOPs, and regulatory requirements, ensuring that all processes align with ICH guidelines and applicable FDA/EMA, PhRMA standards.
* **Inspection readiness:** Perform internal audits and support mock inspections and targeted readiness activities to prepare the organization for regulatory agency visits, including FDA, EMA, MHRA, and other authorities.
* **Collaborate cross-functionally:** Partner with Clinical Operations, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and Laboratory teams to address compliance gaps and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).
* **Documentation review:** Support data integrity and verification of clinical trial master files, laboratory records, and data management systems for completeness, accuracy, and compliance.
* **Administrative & Operational Tasks:** Maintain, update, and archive QMS documentation, including audit reports, inspection responses, SOPs, and compliance records; ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely availability of records.
* **Partnership:** Partner with Clinical QA team to provide compliance training to internal teams and external partners, fostering a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* **Metrics and reporting:** Maintain audit schedules, reports, and performance metrics to ensure transparency and track progress toward quality goals.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify systemic issues and recommend process enhancements that strengthen our QMS and support successful regulatory submissions.
* **Travel:** Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for audits (up to 40%).

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 7+ years in GCP/GCLP auditing or compliance in biotech/pharma.
* Proven experience conducting GCP and/or GCLP audits in a biotech, pharmaceutical, or CRO environment, ideally within late-stage clinical programs.
* Strong knowledge of ICH guidelines, FDA/EMA regulations, and late-stage clinical trial requirements.
* Familiarity with cell therapy, advanced biologics, or other cutting-edge therapeutic modalities is highly desirable.
* Exceptional attention to detail and analytical skills, with the ability to translate findings into actionable improvements.
* Strong interpersonal skills – able to build trust and influence across diverse teams, geographies, and cultures.
* Experience preparing organizations for regulatory inspections and supporting global submissions.
* Auditor certification preferred.
* Must be detail-oriented, precise, and organized in handling documents. Solid organizational skills required; must be able to prioritize multiple tasks.

### **How to Apply**

Please click the link at the bottom of the posting to submit an application.

### **Benefits**

Our most important asset is our people and we offer competitive benefits including health and retirement, PTO, and stock option plans.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Cabaletta Bio is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, national or ethnic origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

#### **The Role**

The Globalization team is dedicated to expanding Block’s multiple brands worldwide. Our mission is to build on Block’s success and continue to deliver innovative, seamless, and fully localized experiences for multilingual Sellers and Customers domestically and abroad.

We are seeking a Quality Program Manager, Globalization to oversee and enhance our quality management at scale. This role involves managing key programs across quality planning, assurance, and control processes. It requires strong collaboration with both cross-functional partners and our suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality. The ultimate goal is to measure, optimize, and sustain quality throughout the localization process in order to protect customer trust, support conversion in global markets, and reduce regulatory risk.

#### **You Will**

* Own and evolve the overall quality program and its strategy for the Globalization team, aligning with broader business goals and KPIs.
* Build robust quality processes that meet the company’s evolving needs, including creating and maintaining clear documentation, providing training, and offering 1:1 support. Serve as the quality expert in the development of linguistic resources and team processes.
* Collect quality data to guide decisions on strategy, budget, initiatives, and vendor resources. Regularly report quality findings in a variety of forums and own data pipelines and dashboards.
* Collaborate with localization vendors and internal teams to analyze quality data, identify opportunities for improvement, manage escalations, develop and refine processes, and maintain accountability for quality metrics.
* Partner with legal, risk, compliance, and product teams to ensure Block’s localization quality program meets regulatory requirements across markets.
* Assess existing tools and collaborate cross-functionally to optimize them through automation as a way to enhance scalability, productivity and efficiency.
* Use AI tools, such as LLM-based translation quality checks, to scale quality evaluation.

#### **You Have**

* 5+ years of experience in the localization industry, with a focus on program management, vendor management, localization quality assurance, and delivering multi-layered projects involving cross-functional collaboration.
* Skilled at defining and delivering results end-to-end against ambiguous problems.
* Comfortable with data analytics - including demonstrated facility with data management tools and advanced analytical platforms, such as Snowflake, Datadog, or similar.
* Hands-on experience with Artificial Intelligence, such as MT/AI quality evaluation and process automation.
* Experience running QA programs, including Terminology Management and Style Guide creation, and familiarity with quality measurement frameworks/models (e.g. MQM/DQF).
* A clear perspective on when and where AI tools and agents help or hurt translation quality and its oversight.
* Experience working with multiple TMS, CMS, and other translation and content management tools.
* Ability to describe linguistic challenges, cultural questions and concepts to stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills paired with excellent presentation skills, especially of complex data for a variety of audiences.
* Strong relationship management skills, with the ability to influence others and build trust.
* Ability to excel in a fast-paced, multicultural team.

#### **Technologies We Use and Teach**

* Contentful, Github, Airtable, Jira, Phrase, Internal tools

-------------------------

--------------------

* Review AI outputs against current defense and intelligence specialists specialist operations workflows, playbooks, and firm policy for Defense and Intelligence Specialists, AI Evaluation assignments.
* Grade tone, escalation logic, and stakeholder fit on a structured rubric.
* Flag operational risk, missed escalations, and policy-adherence gaps with severity tags.
* Capture the right next step so the modeling team can train on it.
* Adjudicate disputed treatments against published playbooks or firm guidance.
* Maintain reviewer-quality scores in inter-rater calibration cycles.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Direct working experience in defense and intelligence specialists specialist operations on real teams for Defense and Intelligence Specialists, AI Evaluation work.
* Comfort applying multi-page rubrics consistently across long batches.
* Clear written reasoning that names the policy or workflow being applied.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to flag when a prompt itself is the problem.
* Reliable async availability for at least 10 hours per week.

**Example tasks**

* Grade a model's response to a real defense and intelligence specialists specialist operations ticket and rate workflow, tone, and escalation.
* Flag a missed escalation with the right severity tag and corrected next step.
* Adjudicate a disputed playbook call between two reviewers using firm guidance.
* Audit a 25-row batch for rubric consistency and report drift to the program lead.

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience training, calibrating, or QA-ing operations teams.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted workflow tooling and its failure modes.
* Bilingual experience for cross-region operations.

**Job Description:**

We are seeking an experienced QA Tester with strong Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS) experience to support State Government healthcare projects. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience testing state Medicaid systems, validating healthcare claims processing, eligibility, enrollment, provider management, and other Medicaid-related functionalities.
  
Candidates with prior experience working directly with State Medicaid Agencies, State Government healthcare programs, or State MMIS modernization projects are highly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing for MMIS applications.

Test EDI transactions, including HIPAA X12 837, 835, 834, and 270/271.

Identify, document, track, and manage defects using tools such as Jira, ALM, or Azure DevOps.
  
Collaborate with Business Analysts, developers, State Medicaid SMEs, and project stakeholders.
  
Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), System Integration Testing (SIT), and production validation.
  
Ensure compliance with Medicaid, CMS, HIPAA, and state-specific healthcare regulations.
  
Participate in State Medicaid system modernization, enhancement, and implementation projects.

**Required Qualifications:**

8+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Testing.
  
Strong hands-on experience with MMIS (Medicaid Management Information System).
  
Must have prior experience working on State Medicaid / State Government healthcare projects.
  
Strong understanding of Medicaid claims processing and adjudication.
  
Experience testing Medicaid eligibility, enrollment, provider management, and member management modules.
  
Hands-on experience with SQL for backend database validation.
  
Experience with EDI transactions (837, 835, 834, 270/271).
  
Strong knowledge of functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
  
Experience preparing test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and defect reports.
  
Familiarity with Medicaid business processes, CMS guidelines, and HIPAA compliance.
  
Experience working with Agile/Scrum and defect management tools.

2cf9fda9636285cd0401.title: Quality Engineer
2cf9fda9636285cd0401.description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

This Quality Engineering role reports to the VP of Quality and is responsible for maintaining and improving compliance of postmarket activities at Beacon Biosignals worldwide. The position will be located in the US, preferably in or near a Beacon hub in Boston or Chicago.

  

**What success looks like:**

* Support of a 21 CFR Part 820 and ISO 13485 compliant postmarket process for complaint handling, supplier management and monitoring, and risk management
* Work with internal stakeholders on the qualification and approval of suppliers. Work with suppliers to address changes, nonconformances, and implement corrective actions, as necessary
* Perform supplier qualification activities, including evaluations and audits (some travel required.)
* Report on supplier performance and manage removal of suppliers when needed.
* Support Complaints, SCARs, CAPAs, and Corrections in compliance with respect to due dates, ensure tasks are completed on time and items are recorded appropriately by responsible personnel.
* Ensure deviations are opened and closed in a timely manner and documentation is compliant
* Up to 20% travel required

  

**What you will bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant scientific/technical field such as Biomedical, Electrical, Systems Engineering or equivalent 5 years experience in a regulated industry
* 5+ years Quality experience in a regulated environment following ISO 13485:2016 and 21CFR Part 820
* Certified Quality Auditor, Certified Quality, Engineer or Certified Software Quality Engineer desired, but not required
* Experience auditing and being audited
* Proven ability to work autonomously with hands-on problem solving expertise and strong analytical skills
* Exceptional interpersonal and relationship-building abilities, with a talent for managing projects and guiding decisions across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to adapt effectively to changing circumstances
* Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing based on risk
* Strong team player, as this position interacts with Beaconeers at multiple sites

The base salary range for this role is $120,000 - $142,000, depending on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications.The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

AI data reviewers help turn image editing qa evaluation outputs into auditable labels, rationales, and regression cases for AuraOne Human Data.

* Capture ambiguous prompts and route them back to the program team for rubric updates.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to flag when a prompt itself is the problem.

5a000d522e98fc04b999.title: Lead Product Enablement Engineer
5a000d522e98fc04b999.description:
**Make banking a Fifth Third better®**  
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

**General Function:**

The Lead Product Enablement Engineer serves as a technology enabler and strategic advisor within the Enterprise Capabilities organization. Work will span from developing and operating prototype framework processes and artifacts through production tooling that others will use to govern Enterprise Capabilities and manage enterprise product development, modernization, and maintenance.

  

This is a hands-on role for an entrepreneurial collaborator, strategist, and builder who can connect human-centered design with strong technical depth on the front and back end. The person in this role will work with capability leaders, product owners, architects, and engineers to define, systematize, and mature the Enterprise Capabilities framework. They may lead a major initiative or several smaller efforts while influencing stakeholders and development teams toward modern, practical solutions. Occasionally, there may be additional opportunities to research and build prototypes and solutions for other areas of need.

  

We are looking for someone with strong curiosity, a forward-looking mindset, and a passion for staying current on engineering trends and emerging technology. The Lead Product Enablement Engineer should be an active user of artificial intelligence and a thoughtful advocate for responsible adoption. This person brings creativity, analytical thinking, and strong communication to the role, using data, prototypes, and other tangible artifacts to explore ideas, improve processes, and help others understand what is possible and how we might achieve it.

  

This role may occasionally work directly with production squads on meaningful, high-priority initiatives to gain understanding of the bank’s technology stack, products, and delivery environment. They will be expected to apply this learning to the development of prototypes, tools, and applications proposed by the team.

  

The Lead Product Enablement Engineer will be responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and personally following policies and procedures as defined. This position acts as the liaison between the Risk, Audit and Analytic teams. Accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the Bank's risk appetite, achieves results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develop a strong understanding of Fifth Third Bank’s current and future-state technology and product architecture
* Help shape the bank’s evolution as a product-led enterprise built on a modern technology foundation
* Identify and prioritize opportunities to expand enterprise technology capabilities in support of customer and product innovation
* Partner with engineers, architects, and line-of-business leaders to envision, demonstrate, and develop new or improved technology-enabled capabilities, business processes, and financial products
* Help define, test, and mature the Enterprise Capabilities framework through collaboration, process design, prototyping, solution development, and documentation
* Build and operate tools for systematizing and scaling the Enterprise Capabilities framework as a practice
* Lead end-to-end data workflows including extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) from structured and unstructured sources; perform quantitative and qualitative analysis; and develop interactive dashboards and visualizations (e.g., Power BI) to support decision-making, stakeholder reporting, and product insights.
* Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to team members and partners
* Use systems thinking to connect ideas across products, platforms, teams, and enterprise capabilities
* Design solutions with the broader business and technology ecosystem in mind
* Apply structured problem solving and root cause analysis to address challenges and uncover new opportunities
* Recommend technology options and design approaches to senior leaders and key stakeholders
* Create compelling narratives, demonstrations, prototypes, and communications that bring concepts to life
* Share lessons learned, best practices, and new ideas across the team and broader organization
* Lead or contribute to research and evaluation of emerging design, technology, industry, and market trends
* Recognize meaningful patterns across industry, technology, and cultural change and explain their business impact
* Translate customer needs, competitor activity, industry shifts, and technology developments into actionable insights
* Influence enterprise thinking on the future of technology across innovation, software development, fintech, artificial intelligence, and digital assets
Identify, evaluate, and benchmark fintechs and emerging startups by analyzing their technology architecture, product capabilities, business models, and financial viability; synthesize findings into comparative assessments and strategic recommendations aligned to enterprise priorities and market relevance.  

  

**Supervisory Responsibilities:** None.

  

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
* 5+ years of experience in roles closely aligned to the responsibilities of this position
* Strong front-end development experience delivering commercial solutions using modern web standards and frameworks such as HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Angular, React, Vue, or similar tools
* Strong back-end development experience working with APIs, services, event-driven architectures using Kafka, databases, SQL, and modern data platforms such as Snowflake, with a clear understanding of how front-end frameworks integrate with back-end systems
* Deep experience with at least one server-side language such as Python, Java, Node.js, or PHP
* Infrastructure experience building, configuring, and supporting scalable web applications in cloud or hosted environments such as AWS or Azure
* Experience with modern server-side tooling, deployment practices, and hosting models
* Experience working in a mature DevOps environment using version control, CI/CD, and automated testing practices
* Proficiency with generative AI for productivity and full-lifecycle software development
* Strong working knowledge of SQL and modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake), along with experience building and consuming data pipelines across both real-time/event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka, APIs) and batch/integration patterns for one-off or analytical use cases
* Familiarity with end-to-end data lifecycle—from ingestion through transformation to visualization—including use of analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI) and/or integrated data platforms (e.g., Dataiku) to support business insights and decision-making
* Strong understanding of agile product development and iterative delivery
* Familiarity with blockchain, digital assets, smart contracts, and web3 technologies
* Past experience with some or all of the following practices: Product Strategy and Planning, Capability Planning, Business Analysis, Business Modeling, Business Architecture, Operating Model Design, or Enterprise Transformation Planning
* Experience evaluating complex business initiatives and identifying cross-functional needs.
* Experience facilitating workshops with business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience developing structured models, frameworks, maps, roadmaps, or decision-support artifacts.
* Experience building functional proof-of-concept applications and using them to communicate a vision
* Ability to make sound design decisions and clearly explain the rationale behind them
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to build trust with team members, business partners, and customers and use those relationships to identify new opportunities
* Commitment to mentoring others and sharing knowledge, best practices, and lessons learned
* Ability to identify meaningful opportunities for change and translate them into effective design or technology responses
* Comfort working iteratively, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and adapting based on feedback
* Strong attention to detail

* Assists with licensing and compliance audits and visits.

6d45aa183d90248f0a4f.description:
***ABOUT MEITHEAL PHARMACEUTICALS***

*Founded in 2017 and based in Chicago, Meitheal is focused on the development and commercialization of generic injectable medications and, as of 2022, has expanded its focus to include fertility, biologic, and branded products. Meitheal currently markets over 75 U.S. FDA-approved products across numerous therapeutic areas including anti-infectives, oncolytics, intensive care, and fertility. As of April 2026, Meitheal, directly or through its partners, has 32 products in the research and development phase, 9 products planned for launch in 2026, 4 products in clinical trial phases, and 13 products under review by the FDA. Meitheal’s mission is to provide easy access to fairly priced products through robust manufacturing, consistent supply, and rapid response to our customers’ needs. Ranked regularly as one of Crain’s Fast 50 in Chicago, and in the top 100 of Crain’s Best Places to Work in Chicago from 2022 to 2026, Meitheal emulates the traditional Irish guiding principle we are named for—working together toward a common goal, for the greater good.*

*Learn more about who we are and what we do at* *www.meithealpharma.com**.*

***The pay range for this position is $350,000 to $425,000 / year. Payrate is determined by considering a person's prior experience and competence.***

*The estimated salary range reflects an anticipated range for this position. The actual base salary offered may depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job. The actual base salary offered will be in accordance with state or local minimum wage requirements for the job location.*

***What We Offer***

* *Competitive pay and medical, dental, and vision insurance*
* *Flexible spending accounts*
* *Long- and short-term disability insurance, as well as life insurance*
* *401(k) plan with match*
* *Competitive PTO and company-paid holidays*
* *Paid parental leave (maternity & paternity)*
* *Employee assistance program*
* *Onsite Gym*

**Summary**

Meitheal Pharmaceuticals is seeking an experienced, commercially focused Executive Vice President, Head of Commercial Access & Operations to lead U.S. market access strategy and commercial operating execution in support of its growing biosimilar portfolio and, as assigned, other Company businesses. This executive will be accountable for payer and channel access, pricing and contracting strategy and execution, commercial launch operational readiness jointly with the EVP, distribution and specialty channel execution, commercial analytics, and operational performance. Product launch strategy is developed and governed cross-functionally across the Company, with the executive leading its market access and commercial operations components. The role requires senior-level relationships with payers, PBMs, GPOs, specialty pharmacies, and distributors, combined with the ability to build disciplined, scalable commercial processes. The position leads the commercial access and operations functions assigned to it and partners with the SVP of Specialty and VP of Biosimilars & Women’s Health on portfolio priorities and commercialization.

**Essential Responsibilities**

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

**Market Access, Pricing & Contracting**

* Develop and execute U.S. market access strategies across pharmacy and medical benefits, retail, specialty, and institutional channels, aligned with cross-functional product and portfolio strategies.
* Lead payer, PBM, health plan, GPO, and strategic account negotiations within approved contracting authority and in coordination with designated business-unit and customer relationship owners to secure favorable formulary positioning, reimbursement, utilization, and profitable access.
* Lead the development and execution of pricing, rebate, contracting, preferred placement, step-therapy, and other compliant access strategies, subject to established pricing, profitability, Legal/Compliance, and executive approval authorities.
* Monitor payer policy, reimbursement trends, competitive launches, and biosimilar adoption to refine commercial plans.

**Commercial Operations & Channel Execution**

* Jointly lead commercial launch operational readiness with including market access, customer onboarding, distribution setup, contract implementation, and operational milestones, as part of the Company’s cross-functional product launch strategy and governance.
* Oversee designated commercial channel relationships and operating performance with wholesalers, specialty distributors, specialty pharmacies, and other channel partners, coordinating with existing relationship owners and Supply Chain.
* Establish effective contract implementation, administration, customer reporting, and performance monitoring processes, in partnership with Finance, Legal, and other functional owners.
* Develop scalable commercial processes, systems requirements, dashboards, and governance for forecasting, demand planning inputs, customer performance, and issue resolution.
* Partner with Supply Chain to align commercial demand, inventory availability, service levels, and customer commitments.
* Ensure market access, contracting, distribution, and channel practices are developed and implemented in coordination with Legal, Compliance, Regulatory, and Finance, including applicable government pricing and pharmaceutical compliance requirements.

**Financial Performance & Business Insights**

* Establish and monitor commercial access and operations KPIs, including preferred access, contract performance, channel utilization, operational launch milestones, and the impact of access and channel strategies on net revenue and profitability.
* Partner with Finance and designated business-unit leaders on product-level P&L reviews, revenue forecasts, gross-to-net assumptions, rebate accrual inputs, contribution margin, and budget discipline; product-level P&L accountability remains with the designated business owner.
* Provide cross-functional recommendations on portfolio and product profitability decisions, including pricing trade-offs, channel mix, contract economics, launch investments, and resource allocation; material decisions remain subject to established Company approval authority.

**Executive Leadership & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Build and lead the commercial access and operations functions assigned to this role, with clear decision rights, functional accountability, and collaborative processes aligned to portfolio scale and launch priorities.
* Coordinate with Specialty and other business-unit leaders, the EVP, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Quality, and Supply Chain to ensure compliant and effective execution.
* Participate in cross-functional business reviews with Finance, Supply Chain, and portfolio leaders to assess performance against product P&L plans, identify variances and corrective actions, and present commercial recommendations to executive leadership.
* Escalate unresolved disagreements over product priorities, customer ownership, pricing economics, or operational execution through the Company’s established cross-functional governance and executive decision-making processes.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Directly oversee team responsible for Commercial Access and Operations
* Provides leadership, coaching, performance management, and strategic direction for growth of biosimilar portfolio

**Core Competencies**

* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Strategic thinker with outstanding analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to engage internal and external stakeholders, and commercial teams.
* Strong operational execution, balancing high-level strategic vision with hands-on leadership.
* Comprehensive knowledge of regulatory requirements, compliance, and industry standards.

**Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Required: Direct, substantive Medical Affairs leadership experience with biosimilars, including at least one U.S. biosimilar launch or significant prelaunch commercialization program.
* Required: Working knowledge of FDA biosimilar regulatory pathways, interchangeability, extrapolation, immunogenicity, and scientific communication to healthcare professionals.
* Strongly preferred: Experience supporting biosimilar formulary adoption, payer evidence needs, provider switching education, and collaboration with Market Access.

**Education and/or Experience Required**

* MD, PhD, or PharmD required.
* Minimum 15+ years of experience in Pharma/Biotech, 10+ years Medical Affairs department, including leadership roles in biotech/pharmaceutical companies.

**Computer Skills**

**Physical Demands**

**Work Environment**

a8e8e557864060ebbf1f.description:
Hundred turns a member's health data (labs, medical records, biometrics and wearables) into a personalized, evidence-based 100-day action plan. We offer advanced lab testing, clinician-guided care and prescription programs in hormone health, metabolic health and longevity, all through one app. Hundred turns data into direction.

**The role**

You'll be the first hire on our Clinical Operations team, working directly with our Head of Clinical Operations. You'll own the day-to-day of our care operations: keeping prescription orders moving, solving pharmacy and lab issues, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks for our members. You'll also help us test new features, write our playbooks and automate what we do by hand. It's part clinical operations, part clinical product, and you'll help build the department from the ground up.

**What you'll do**

* Monitor prescription orders daily and resolve anything stuck, delayed or rejected before members notice
* Own issue triage with our pharmacy and lab partners: delays, backorders, substitutions and shipping problems
* Route clinical questions and escalations to the right provider and close the loop with members
* Support new pharmacy and partner program launches, from setup and testing through go-live
* Lead user acceptance testing for new app and EMR features, and write clear bug reports
* Triage supplement and marketplace order issues
* Write and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs)
* Find manual steps we can automate, and work with Engineering to ship them
* Pitch in on protocol review and member support during busy periods

**Your first 100 days**

* **Month 1:** Learn our systems and map the full care workflow, from order to delivery and from lab results to protocol
* **Month 2:** Set up our pharmacy and lab issue process, lead testing for a release, and write the first core SOPs
* **Month 3:** Run day-to-day operations on your own, deliver your first automations, and share your plan for the next six months

**What you bring**

* 2+ years in clinical operations at a health startup, telehealth or digital health company
* Hands-on experience with pharmacy and lab workflows (e-prescribing, compounding or specialty pharmacy a plus)
* Comfort with lots of tools at once: EMRs, admin dashboards, pharmacy portals, Jira and spreadsheets
* Strong follow-through. You close every loop and can prioritize a busy queue on your own.
* Clear, friendly written communication with clinicians, partners and members
* HIPAA training and good judgment with health information

**Nice to have**

* A clinical background (RN, LPN, MA, CPhT or similar)
* Experience with hormone, GLP-1, metabolic or longevity programs
* Experience in product operations or user acceptance testing
* Familiarity with LifeFile, Medplum and Clinical Intelligence Tools

966937ad9adebe8d6e2b.title: Vice President of Strategic Planning
966937ad9adebe8d6e2b.description:
Marous Brothers Construction is a family-owned commercial construction company with more than four decades of experience delivering projects across the United States.

The company provides construction management, design-build, general contracting, site development, and specialized construction services. Its projects span commercial offices, multifamily housing, healthcare, education, industrial facilities, hospitality, and public infrastructure.

Marous Brothers has built its reputation through hands-on project management, strong client relationships, and the ability to manage complex construction work from initial planning through completion.

As the company continues to expand its project portfolio and geographic reach, strategic planning plays an important role in identifying new markets, evaluating business opportunities, and maintaining sustainable financial performance.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Vice President of Strategic Planning to work closely with executive leadership on the company's long-term business direction and growth priorities.

This is a senior leadership position for someone who understands the construction industry from both a commercial and financial perspective.

You'll help evaluate where the company should grow, which markets offer the strongest opportunities, and how resources should be allocated across different business units and project types.

The role requires someone who can connect strategic planning with actual business performance. That means understanding construction demand, project profitability, client relationships, operating capacity, and the financial requirements of entering new markets.

We're looking for a business-minded executive who can bring thoughtful analysis to important decisions and help turn growth plans into practical operating priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Lead corporate strategic planning initiatives and work with executive leadership to establish long-term business objectives.

Evaluate new geographic markets, construction sectors, and commercial opportunities to identify areas for expansion.

Work with finance and operations leadership to assess revenue forecasts, project margins, operating budgets, capital requirements, and business performance.

Analyze construction market conditions, competitor activity, customer demand, and industry trends to support strategic decisions.

Evaluate potential partnerships, acquisition opportunities, joint ventures, and other opportunities to strengthen the company's market position.

Develop financial and commercial business cases for major projects, new service offerings, and proposed market expansion initiatives.

Collaborate with construction management, design-build, business development, and project operations teams to improve coordination between strategic priorities and project execution.

Review project portfolio performance, backlog trends, resource utilization, and operating efficiency to identify opportunities for improvement.

Work with executive leadership to establish performance indicators and monitor progress against strategic objectives.

Prepare strategic recommendations, financial analysis, and business development reports for executive leadership.

Qualifications and Experience

Candidates should have **15 to 20 years of professional experience** in corporate strategy, construction management, business development, financial management, or strategic operations.

We prefer **8 to 12 years of management experience**, including responsibility for business units, strategic initiatives, or cross-functional leadership teams.

A strong understanding of corporate finance, financial forecasting, budgeting, investment analysis, and business performance management is essential.

Experience in commercial construction, real estate development, infrastructure, engineering services, or construction management would be particularly valuable.

Candidates should understand project economics, construction costs, contract profitability, capital allocation, and the financial considerations involved in expanding an established construction business.

Experience evaluating new markets, negotiating strategic partnerships, and working with senior executives is highly desirable.

Strong analytical skills, business judgment, and the ability to communicate complex recommendations clearly are essential.

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. An MBA or relevant advanced qualification would be an advantage.

Leadership Expectations

The ideal candidate understands that successful growth in construction requires more than winning additional projects. It requires the right clients, disciplined financial decisions, reliable execution, and the ability to maintain strong operating standards as the business expands.

We're looking for someone who can think strategically while remaining connected to the financial and operational realities of the construction industry.

You should be comfortable working with executive leadership, challenging existing assumptions, and developing recommendations that support the company's long-term success.

14d295cf7b33f4a86fd7.title: Community Partnerships Coordinator – Senior Care
14d295cf7b33f4a86fd7.description:
AskJoy is hiring a part-time or contract Caregiver Referral Network Lead to build the local network of trusted people who send older adults and their families to AskJoy. You'll start at 10–20 hours a week, on a 3–6 month contract, with a path to a full-time role if the network takes off.

**About AskJoy.** AskJoy protects the money of adults 55+, especially those on a fixed income. It finds and cancels unwanted subscriptions, flags scams and duplicate charges, helps with medical bills and insurance overlaps, and steps in to help recover after a scam. It works over regular text messages, a real person takes over when the AI can't finish, and AskJoy can never move money or make purchases. Adult children can join through Family Hub, and the senior decides what they see.

**Why this role matters.** Older adults don't find help like this in app stores. They hear about it from someone they trust: a care manager, an elder law attorney, their pastor, the Area Agency on Aging, a Medicare counselor. Your job is to earn that trust, one relationship at a time.

What you'll do

* **Map the local network.** Build a target list of the referral sources that matter in [launch metro]: Area Agencies on Aging, geriatric care managers (Aging Life Care Association members), elder law attorneys, State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) counselors, home care agencies and franchises, faith communities, senior centers, libraries and AARP chapters.
* **Open doors and build relationships.** Meet referral sources in person and by phone. Learn what their clients struggle with, explain how AskJoy helps, and make referring easy.
* **Turn contacts into regular referrers.** Equip each partner with simple materials (a one-page handout, a referral link or code, a short script), then follow up until they send families regularly.
* **Run community sessions.** Lead or coordinate short, practical talks such as scam-awareness workshops, Medicare bill clinics and "help your parent with subscriptions" sessions for adult children at senior centers, churches, libraries and retirement communities.
* **Track everything.** Keep the referral pipeline current: who you met, what stage they're at, how many signups they've sent. Report weekly on what's working.
* **Bring back what you hear.** Share caregiver and partner feedback with the founder so it shapes the product, the pricing and the materials.
* **Flag bigger opportunities.** When a credit union, senior living community or health plan contact shows interest in paying for AskJoy for their members, hand it to the founder or the partnerships lead.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years building referral relationships in aging services, for example as a hospice or home health community liaison, a home care business development rep, a senior living community relations director, or a geriatric care or social work role with outreach duties.
* An existing network among care managers, discharge planners, elder law attorneys, Area Agency on Aging staff or faith communities.
* A track record of turning one-time contacts into steady referral sources, with numbers you can share.
* Comfort presenting to small groups of older adults and their families, in plain language and with patience.
* The discipline to work independently, keep a pipeline current and report honestly on what isn't working.
* A car and willingness to travel locally several days a week.
* Comfortable using Google Suite, Slack and CRM.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with Medicare, insurance or billing questions, or with elder fraud and financial exploitation cases.
* Ties to credit unions, senior centers or local AARP chapters.
* Spanish, Mandarin, Vietnamese or another language spoken by older adults in [launch metro].
* Personal experience as a family caregiver.
* An existing network in [launch metro] among care managers, discharge planners, elder law attorneys, Area Agency on Aging staff or faith communities.
* A track record of turning one-time contacts into steady referral sources, with numbers you can share.
* Comfort presenting to small groups of older adults and their families, in plain language and with patience.
* The discipline to work independently, keep a pipeline current and report honestly on what isn't working.
* A car and willingness to travel locally several days a week.

Visit askjoynow.com to learn more about the company.

Pay: $25.64 - $30.88 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 20.0 per week

Experience:

* Aging Services: 3 years (Required)
* Google Suite: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

**Company Description**

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.

In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 47,000 staff across a network of more than 900 independent companies in over 50 countries and operating more than 800 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.

In 2019, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 4.56 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Key Responsibilities

Business Leadership & Strategy

* Lead all business unit activities to achieve revenue, profitability, and operational performance objectives.
* Develop and execute annual business plans aligned with company growth strategies.
* Manage the laboratory's P&L, budgets, forecasting, and financial performance.
* Identify market opportunities, competitive trends, and customer needs to support strategic growth initiatives.

Commercial & Client Development

* Support pricing strategies, contract negotiations, and business development initiatives.

Laboratory Operations

* Direct daily laboratory operations to ensure efficient workflow, quality delivery, and customer responsiveness.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on productivity, cost management, quality, and turnaround time.
* Ensure staffing levels, training programs, and resource allocation support business growth and operational objectives.
* Lead performance management, succession planning, and employee development efforts.
* Promote a culture of accountability, operational excellence, collaboration, and safety.

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

* Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory, accreditation, and quality system requirements.
* Support adherence to ISO 17025 standards and other relevant federal, state, and industry regulations.
* Partner with technical and quality teams to drive audit readiness and continuous quality improvement.
* Ensure laboratory operations meet client expectations and applicable service-level agreements.

People Leadership

* Lead, mentor, and develop managers, supervisors, and staff.
* Foster employee engagement through effective communication, coaching, and recognition.
* Build a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, customer service, quality, and innovation.
* Recruit and retain top talent to support current and future business objectives.

 **Qualifications**

Required

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Biology, Industrial Hygiene, Engineering, or related discipline.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive leadership experience within laboratory testing, environmental services, industrial hygiene, analytical testing, or a related technical services industry.

The successful candidate will be:

* Capable of driving profitable growth while maintaining exceptional quality and client service.
* Experienced in laboratory environments serving environmental, industrial hygiene, or built environment markets.
* Comfortable leading change, improving processes, and scaling operations.
* Customer-focused, financially savvy, and highly accountable for results.

EVOLUTION:  
  
In a fast growing group, successful leaders are frequently being offered increased areas of responsibility (subject to geographic mobility).  
  
Eurofins offers international opportunities to strong performers.
