**Technical Program Manager II**

itD is seeking an Incident Communications & Program Manager to support advertising platform reliability for a leading global technology organization. This role will own day-to-day incident communications, including deciding when a communication is needed, drafting it, taking it through Legal approval, and publishing it. It will also run readiness for major advertiser sales events and build AI-driven workflow automations. The ideal candidate will bring strong writing under time pressure, experience in technical, incident, or crisis communications or program coordination, hands-on use of generative AI tools, and the judgment to run recurring operational work independently, including a higher level of on-call responsibility. This is a 12-month contract with potential for extension.

**Location:** Remote - US (candidates must work in Pacific, Central, or Mountain time)

**Duration:** 12 months

We provide comprehensive medical benefits, a 401k plan, paid holidays, and more. Please note that we are only considering direct W2 candidates at this time, as we are unable to offer sponsorship.

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve on the incident communications on-call rotation and work with incident managers to decide whether an incident needs communications, using defined criteria (severity, revenue impact, number of affected advertisers, duration).
* Draft advertiser-facing, sales-facing, and leadership communications for incidents of all severity levels, translating technical root causes into plain, accurate language.
* Run the approval process with Legal, advertiser communications, incident managers, and policy partners, then publish approved messages to the right sales and leadership channels within target timelines.
* Track follow-ups after mitigation, including refund timelines and revenue impact, and send recap communications to leadership.
* Keep the communications playbook and library of pre-approved, plug-and-play templates current, and draft new templates and take them through Legal and Sales approval.
* Escalate to the program TPM only for exceptions such as unclear criteria, disputed approvals, or high-visibility incidents.
* Run day-to-day readiness for major advertiser sales events (such as Black Friday) and major customer product launches, including kickoff, preparation checklists, task owners, and deadlines.
* Coordinate engineering, sales, support, and partner teams before, during, and after each event, and escalate open incidents that threaten an event to their owners.
* Run event command-center communications, status updates, and post-event summaries.
* Execute other short-duration programs as assigned by the program TPM (for example tooling migrations, holiday on-call scheduling, and cross-team outreach campaigns) with clear plans, trackers, and status reporting.
* Keep processes, playbooks, checklists, and trackers current as the program evolves, and propose improvements to the program TPM.
* Use AI assistants daily to draft communications, summarize incidents and meetings, and prepare status updates.
* Build, test, and maintain AI-driven automations, such as an incident alert that creates a task, checks for a related incident, and drafts a communication for human approval.
* Monitor automated workflows, catch and fix failures, and keep humans in the loop on approvals.

**Internal Responsibilities:**

* Attend regular internal practice community meetings.
* Collaborate with your itD practice team on industry thought leadership.
* Complete client case studies and learning material (blogs, media material).
* Build out material to contribute to the Digital Transformation practice.
* Attend internal itD networking events (in person and virtual).
* Work with leadership on career fast-track opportunities.

**Required Qualifications and Skills:**

* 4+ years in technical communications, incident or crisis communications, or program coordination at a technology company.
* Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to turn complex technical information into clear, accurate messages for advertisers, sales teams, and executives under time pressure.
* Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in daily work and building automated workflows with AI or low-code tools.
* Proven ability to run recurring operational work independently with little supervision and to know when to escalate.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional programs or events with many stakeholders and tight deadlines.
* Comfort working with Legal and communications approval processes.
* Organized and reliable on an on-call rotation, including during live incidents and peak-season workload.
* Discretion in handling confidential incident and advertiser information, following Legal-approved communication processes and data confidentiality policies.

**Preferred Qualifications and Skills:**

* Experience in digital advertising or ad tech, especially advertiser-facing operations.
* Familiarity with incident management concepts (severity levels, mitigation, post-incident review).
* Experience supporting peak retail or sales events.
* Experience with task trackers, dashboards, and Slack-based workflows.

**Education:**  
Bachelor's degree required.

**Company Description**  
About itD: We are part of a new generation of consulting and software development company that blends diversity, innovation, and integrity with real business results. Our structure rejects any strong hierarchy, empowering us to deliver excellent results. We are a woman- and minority-led firm. Every day, we challenge ourselves to be considerate, fair and to re-think what great outcomes mean for our customers. This permeates down to how we approach every interaction, on every project, for every client. You'll thrive here if you are a dynamic self-starter, a difference-maker or someone who wants to deliver great results, without constraints.

The itD Digital Experience: Joining us means you'll be part of our global community, you have a say about your own career journey, and you'll get a chance to give back to causes that matter. You will experience working with Fortune 500 companies and high-performance teams across numerous industries. itD offers our employees excellent benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life insurance, paid holidays, 401K + matching, networking & career learning and development programs. We are growing and we want to see you grow! Visit https://itdtech.com/careers to learn more about what working at itD can mean for you.

Dynamic environment in a culture of respect, empowerment and recognition for a job well done, apply today!

530fb6f9af4ea20fd71c.title: Program Coordinator, Philadelphia Sexual Assault Response
530fb6f9af4ea20fd71c.description:
PHMC serves as both a direct service provider to individuals, families, and communities across the region and an intermediary agent—managing large-scale contracts, government and philanthropic partnerships, and multidisciplinary initiatives that require operational sophistication, strategic leadership, and deep mission alignment.

**COMPONENT:**

City

**DIVISION:**

Philadelphia Department of Public Health – Division of Reproductive, Adolescent, and Child Health

**LOCATION**:

300 East Hunting Park

**REPORTS TO:**

Clinical Director/Manager

**Schedule:**

Monday-to-Friday, 9 am to 5 pm

**FTE Status**-Full-Time

**Job Overview:**

ReACH is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and dependable Administrative Program Coordinator to provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to the Philadelphia Sexual Assault Response Center (PSARC). PSARC provides trauma-informed, patient-centered forensic medical services to individuals who have experienced sexual assault. The Program Administrator plays an essential role in supporting the center’s mission by facilitating efficient daily operations, maintaining organizational systems, coordinating staff activities, and ensuring timely communication among internal and external stakeholders. The person in this position will serve as the primary administrative support to the Clinical Director/Manager and help coordinate the administrative functions needed to maintain a 24-hour sexual assault response program.

This position requires a high degree of professionalism, discretion, initiative, accountability, and the ability to independently manage competing administrative priorities.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Executive and Administrative Support.**

* Provide direct administrative support for daily program operations.
* Monitor designated administrative email accounts and ensure timely routing and follow-up of correspondence.
* Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems for forensic medical records, District Attorney and private attorney legal requests, and witness subpoenas.
* Track assigned projects, deadlines, pending requests, and outstanding action items.
* Assist with preparing presentations, operational reports, meeting materials, program flyers, folders, and program updates.
* Maintain confidentiality regarding personnel, survivors, legal, and organizational information.

* **Assist with Staff Scheduling and Personnel Coordination**

* Coordinate and maintain the Sexual Assault Nurse Examiner (SANE) on-call schedule.
* Monitor scheduling gaps and promptly notify the Clinical Director of anticipated coverage concerns.
* Communicate with SANEs regarding scheduling requests, availability, meetings, training, and administrative announcements.
* Maintain administrative records of staff certifications, continuing education, mandatory training, and credential expiration dates.
* Maintain accurate staff contact lists, availability records, and scheduling documentation.
* Assist with onboarding new employees, including tracking required documentation, training completion, and orientation schedules.
* Track staff meeting attendance and required administrative submissions.

* **Program Operations and Office Management**

* Support the daily administrative operations of PSARC to promote efficiency, organization, and continuity of services.
* Maintain an inventory of office supplies, administrative materials, and designated program equipment.
* Coordinate supply requests, purchasing documentation, vendor communication, and delivery tracking.
* Maintain administrative logs, operational checklists, and equipment maintenance schedules.
* Assist with organizing workspaces and maintaining a professional, welcoming, and trauma-informed environment.
* Support the implementation and maintenance of program policies, procedures, forms, and operational workflows.
* Identify administrative inefficiencies and recommend improvements to the Clinical Director.

* **Data Collection, Reporting, and Quality Improvement**

* Assist with collecting, organizing, and maintaining program statistics and administrative performance data.
* Maintain tracking spreadsheets and databases for program activities, staffing, training, and operational metrics.
* Assist the Clinical Director with preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual reports.
* Track designated program performance indicators and administrative compliance requirements.
* Maintain accurate records for audits, program evaluations, and quality improvement initiatives.
* Monitor completion of assigned administrative corrective actions and provide status updates to the Clinical Director.
* Ensure that data collection and reporting activities comply with confidentiality and organizational requirements.

* **Medical Records and Legal Administrative Coordination**

* Maintain secure administrative tracking systems for medical records requests, subpoenas, and other legal correspondence.
* Forward requests to the appropriate legal or records department in accordance with established procedures.
* Monitor request status, document correspondence, and follow up on outstanding administrative actions.
* Assist with maintaining organized documentation related to evidence transfer and chain-of-custody administrative tracking, as authorized.
* Ensure all confidential records and communications are handled according to applicable privacy laws, organizational policies, and established procedures.

**Skills:**

* Ability to protect sensitive survivor, employee, and organizational information.
* Ability to provide compassionate, professional, and nonjudgmental assistance.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities.
* Ability to identify administrative challenges and recommend solutions.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, and Outlook.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
* Ability to assist with budgets, invoices, purchasing, and expense tracking.
* Ability to recognize boundaries and refer sensitive matters to leadership.

**Experience:**

* At least two years of experience managing daily office operations and administrative functions
* Familiarity with trauma-informed and survivor-centered practices preferred
* Experience maintaining confidential records and sensitive information preferred

**Education Requirement:**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Office Management, Public Administration, Human Services, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent education and relevant work experience may be considered.
* Additional training in confidentiality, trauma-informed practices, victim services, or nonprofit administration is desirable

**Salary:**

$55,000 - $65,000 depending on experience

**Contact Information:**

Shaneita Goode: shaneita.goode@phila.gov (mailto:shaneita.goode@phila.gov)

PHMC is an Equal Opportunity and E-Verify Employer.

#### **Experience**

Required

* 2 year(s): Two (2) years of experience managing daily office operations and administrative functions.

#### **Education**

Preferred

* Bachelors or better in Business Administation or related field
* Associates or better in Business Administation or related field

#### **Skills**

Preferred

* Active Listening
* Electronic Health Records (EHR)
* Customer Service
* Verbal Communication
* Microsoft Office Suite

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

7838da01e5eb47a305c9.title: Family Services Coordinator
7838da01e5eb47a305c9.description:
**Seeking: Family Services Coordinator- Full Time-Remote position-** **Only seeking candidates who reside in the following States- AL, AZ, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, KS, MA, MD, MI, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NM, NV, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA**

Are you searching for a job with a company that offers paid on-the-job training and development, competitive wages? Perhaps you are looking to join a high-performing team that’s focused on improving the lives of others? Or are you thinking about making a career change into a new and exciting line of work? If the answer to any of these questions is “Yes!”, then keep reading!

CorneaGen is a mission-driven company focused on advancing ocular care through meaningful innovations that transform patient lives while honoring every donor gift. Guided by our commitments to Trusted Tissue Stewardship, Exceptional Service, and Advancing Eye Care, we strive to make a lasting difference for patients, surgeons, partners, and the communities we serve. In support of this goal, we are looking for a Family Services Coordinator- Full Time to join our team.

**What does a Family Services Coordinator do?**

The **Family Services Coordinator** contributes to a dynamic industry which operates 24 hours a day, 7 days per week; serves as the point of contact regarding incoming referrals, coordinates specific functions of the donation program including receiving initial referrals and assessing/determining donor potential for CorneaGen and with all external donation partners, and directs recovery arrangements. The FSC is responsible for working with families to provide information regarding donation opportunities & obtaining authorization.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Job Location**

* This is a remote/work-from home position
* Shifts are composed of 12-hour increments (subject to change). Work hours will primarily include evenings and weekends.

**Referrals and Donor Screening**

* + Handles inbound and outbound communication with donation stakeholders such as hospitals/hospices/medical examiner offices/funeral homes and assesses suitability for eye donation
  + Captures all information timely, accurately, and completely within donor management software
  + Provides comprehensive medical screening of potential donors by effectively communicating with referral source personnel to determine suitability for eye recovery based on established guidelines
  + Discusses screening information and criteria applications with Family Services Director accordingly
  + Routinely provides feedback to appropriate chain of management regarding hospital education needs, community outreach opportunities, and development with donation partner agencies

**Donor Advocacy and Logistics**

* + Works in close collaboration with hospitals, team members, and Family Services Director to evaluate and determine the best time to offer families the opportunity for donation
  + Leads donation discussion with potential donor families or agents
  + Effectively advocates for donation and ensures informed consent to potential donor families; completes authorization for donation; obtains and documents accurate medical/social histories
  + Provides support and education to families throughout the donation process
  + Coordinates all logistical aspects required for donation to occur, including interfacing with other participating agencies such as recovery partners, hospitals, medical examiners, and funeral directors
  + Coordinates recovery location and timing; activates/assigns recovery staff for eye recovery
  + Ensures that case documentation within donation software is updated accurately and in a timely manner
  + Maintains a high sense of urgency to ensure optimal time frames for recovery
  + Works to utilize resources and reduce inefficiencies
  + Strives to meet and/or exceed critical KPIs that drive organizational success including but not limited to; authorization rate, suitability rate, call volume and error rate
  + Collaborates with appropriate personnel to troubleshoot real-time challenges

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Possess advanced knowledge related to donor evaluation and management
* Exhibits superb customer service skills
* Able to maintain professionalism during potentially complex circumstances
* Possesses an advanced understanding of national regulations and procedures surrounding donation, and an advanced clinical and anatomical knowledge
* Demonstrates both a strong work ethic and efficient productivity in an independent work environment
* Ability to communicate and present information effectively and concisely within a team environment
* Proactive team player who can multitask with ease, and uphold organizational core values
* Must possess strong interpersonal, priority-setting and strategic skills. Strong attention to detail, written and verbal communication skills. Thrives in a fast-paced dynamic environment and adjusts to new priorities as required
* Well-spoken, has the ability to communicate appropriately and effectively over the phone, especially with families in the midst of their grieving process
* Knowledgeable about medical terminology
* Proficient in critical thinking
* Able to work nights, days, weekends, holidays; willingness and flexibility to adapt to schedule adjustments as needed

**What if I’ve never done this type of work before?**

Not a problem! We will provide on-the-job training to give you the skills and knowledge needed to become a Family Services Coordinator. What we ask of you is:

* Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in biologic sciences- or an equivalent degree/diploma/certification in an allied health field. Minimum of 3 years of experience may substitute for educational requirement.
* Prior Donor Coordination experience strongly preferred

**What compensation and benefits do you offer?**

The minimum hourly rate for this position is $24.00/hour and a maximum hourly rate is $27.00/hour. Individual compensation will vary within this range based on a candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience as they relate to the requirements for this position. Shift Premium of $2.00/hour for nights and weekends. Bilingual Premium of $1.50/hour.

Our benefits package includes:

* Generous employer-paid health benefits (medical, dental and vision premiums) for all employees, plus minimal premium contributions to cover dependents
* Retirement benefits, with a 5% company match plus opportunities for additional employer contributions.
* Paid time off, including 12 company holidays and 2+ weeks of PTO, with opportunities to accrue additional PTO based on tenure.
* Costco or similar wholesale club membership reimbursement.
* Short-term and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, and more!

**This sounds great – I’m ready to apply!**  
Fantastic! We look forward to receiving your online application at CorneaGen.com; our recruiting team reviews applications on a frequent basis and will contact you via email if we’d like to talk with you further.

As an equal opportunity employer, every qualified applicant will be considered for employment. CorneaGen does not discriminate based on race, color, sex/gender, political ideology, religion/creed, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, national origin, color, military or veteran’s status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other status or characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws. CorneaGen is committed to a diverse workforce and is also committed to a barrier-free employment process. In order to ensure reasonable accommodations with Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, individuals that require accommodations in the job application process for a posted position may contact us at (206) 701-5840 for assistance.

acabbe7abd9498249bfe.title: Clinical TA Offer Coordinator
acabbe7abd9498249bfe.description:
POSITION PURPOSE

The Clinical TA Offer Coordinator manages the operational execution and quality of the provider offer process, from approved offer terms through document completion and accurate handoff. This role safeguards the candidate experience by coordinating offer documentation, electronic signatures, data accuracy, and risk-related follow-up across Talent Acquisition and its partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Offer Workflow Ownership. Coordinate the offer lifecycle for physicians and other clinical providers, including Letters of Intent (LOIs), Employment Agreements (EAs), Offer Letters (OLs), and independent contractor/1099 agreements, using approved terms, templates, and established approval pathways.
* Agreement Quality Control. Complete a documented pre-release review for consistency among approved offer terms, compensation and commencement details, employer/entity and practice information, candidate identifiers, effective dates, signature blocks, exhibits, and required supporting documents. Route discrepancies to the appropriate owner before release.
* Electronic Signature and Storage. Prepare and route documents through approved eSignature workflows; monitor completion, reminders, revisions, and countersignatures; maintain correctly named, access-controlled final agreements and a reliable central TA document repository.
* ATS Data Integrity. Maintain accurate offer-stage information, key dates, approvals, document status, and supporting records in ATS. Audit records for completeness, promptly resolve discrepancies, and support trustworthy operational reporting.
* Cross-functional Coordination. Partner with recruiters, practice/operations leaders, Legal, HR, Credentialing, and other stakeholders to reconcile start dates, contracting updates, document changes, and time-sensitive handoffs. Track open items through closure and communicate status and ownership.
* Attestations and Risk Escalation. Manage collection, tracking, and follow-up of required candidate attestations and related disclosures. Identify missing, inconsistent, or potentially concerning information and promptly escalate it to designated Legal, Compliance, or other decisionmakers without making independent legal or eligibility determinations.
* Process Improvement. Maintain checklists, standard work, queue visibility, and issue logs. Recommend improvements that reduce errors, rework, avoidable delays, and candidate confusion while preserving necessary approval controls.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Required

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in high-accuracy document administration, offer or contract coordination, recruiting operations, HR operations, or a comparable controlled-workflow function.
* Demonstrated ability to review complex, detail-sensitive documents for consistency and completeness and manage multiple concurrent transactions with firm deadlines.
* Strong business writing, stakeholder follow-up, confidentiality, and proficiency with Microsoft Office, electronic document systems, and shared records.
* Associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience accepted.

Preferred

* 3+ years of relevant experience, particularly in provider recruiting, healthcare workforce operations, contract administration, or offer management.
* Experience in a paralegal, legal assistant, or contract-coordinator environment, with a clear understanding of administrative versus legal decision-making responsibilities.
* Working knowledge of ATS; experience with DocuSign/Adobe Sign or equivalent eSignature and platforms.
* Experience with clinical employment documentation, approvals, and sensitive candidate disclosures.

CORE CAPABILITIES

Exceptional attention to detail; structured organization; proactive issue escalation; sound judgment; strong service orientation; comfort working across Recruiting, Legal, HR, and Operations; ability to maintain control without creating unnecessary delays.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS

* Offer document accuracy and first-pass completion rate; frequency of preventable corrections or rework.
* Turnaround time from approved terms to document release and from release to full execution.
* Completeness and timeliness of Greenhouse records, final-file retention, and attestation follow-up.
* Aging of outstanding approvals, signatures, and escalated issues; quality of stakeholder communication.

ROLE BOUNDARIES & DECISION RIGHTS

The coordinator executes approved processes and highlights variances. Recruiters and designated business approvers own commercial offer terms; Legal and Compliance own legal interpretation, risk adjudication, and approval of contract language.

GENERAL EXPECTATIONS

Deliver accurate work on deadline; protect confidential information; communicate professionally; collaborate across teams; maintain reliable records; escalate issues promptly; and support continuous improvement. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform essential functions.

Work environment: Professional, computer-based role involving telephone/video communication and routine use of office equipment. Final physical requirements and job classification are subject to HR review.

ed69239871aff84fb6cb.title: Clinical TA Intake Coordinator
ed69239871aff84fb6cb.description:
POSITION PURPOSE

The Clinical TA Intake Coordinator serves as the first response and scheduling hub for inbound clinical applicants. This role converts timely, professional outreach into completed recruiter screening appointments, ensures accurate candidate routing and ATS records, and strengthens intake quality by identifying avoidable process-related rejections. The coordinator supports recruiter productivity through speed, responsiveness, disciplined follow-up, and a consistent candidate experience.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Candidate Experience and Conversion. Manage incoming applications and assigned leads; make prompt, personalized contact within TA-established response standards using approved phone, email, and text channels.
* Direct Recruiter Scheduling. Identify the appropriate recruiter; coordinate candidate availability and schedule screening appointments directly on recruiter calendars. Confirm time zones, send clear meeting details, and manage rescheduling and missed-appointment follow-up.
* Initial Intake and Routing. Collect limited, standardized intake information needed for efficient recruiter engagement; confirm basic nonclinical details, identify duplicates, document candidate preferences, and flag questions for recruiter review.
* APP, RT, and CRNA Triage. Prioritize inbound applicants (Advanced Practice Provider, Radiation Therapist, and CRNA) and schedule recruiter screens as capacity and defined workflows permit. Apply differentiated response expectations so these populations do not displace the physician service standard.
* Rejection-Reason Quality Control. Audit pre-presentation dispositions and rejection reasons for completeness, consistent categorization, and process accuracy. Surface recurring patterns and potential missed engagement opportunities to recruiters and leadership; request corrections through the established review process.
* Candidate Experience and ATS Integrity. Maintain clear, professional candidate communication and accurate Greenhouse activities, stages, contact attempts, notes, routing, and appointments. Close the loop on inquiries and handoffs so applicants are not lost between intake and recruiter review.
* Reporting and Department Projects. Track contact, scheduling, show-rate, and intake quality measures. Support TA process-improvement and special projects when coverage permits, with physician intake responsiveness remaining the first priority.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Required

* At least 1 year of relevant experience in inside sales, high-volume recruiting or recruiting coordination, candidate engagement, customer success, contact-center operations, or high-volume appointment scheduling.
* Demonstrated success with time-sensitive follow-up, professional phone communication, multi-channel outreach, and scheduling across multiple calendars.
* Ability to navigate high volumes of competing requests while maintaining accurate records, confidentiality, and a positive customer or candidate experience.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Outlook/calendar tools and basic Microsoft Office applications; degree not required when relevant experience is demonstrated.

Preferred

* 2–3 years of experience in high-volume recruiting, sales/ sales development, healthcare recruitment support, medical office intake, or a comparable service-intensive role.
* Experience with ATS / CRM system(s), including stage updates, contact logging, workflow queues, and reports.
* Evidence of performance against response-time, appointment-setting, conversion, attendance, or service-quality targets.
* Familiarity with physician, APP, Radiation Therapist, or CRNA recruiting workflows, or demonstrated ability to learn specialist terminology quickly.

CORE CAPABILITIES

Urgency with accuracy; strong phone and written communication; consultative questioning; respectful persistence; disciplined scheduling; excellent candidate service; comfort with performance metrics and coaching.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS

* Physician time-to-first-attempt, time-to-live-contact, and percentage reached within established response standards.
* Qualified inbound leads converted to booked recruiter screens; scheduling turnaround and screen attendance/show rate.
* Accuracy and completeness of intake and rejection-reason dispositions; minimize pre-presentation process losses.
* ATS record accuracy, handoff completeness, and adherence to physician-priority routing expectations.

ROLE BOUNDARIES & DECISION RIGHTS

The coordinator owns outreach, routing, scheduling, intake documentation, and reason-code audits. Recruiters own substantive qualification, presentation, and rejection decisions. The coordinator must not change disposition decisions to improve metrics.

GENERAL EXPECTATIONS

Deliver accurate work on deadline; protect confidential information; communicate professionally; collaborate across teams; maintain reliable records; escalate issues promptly; and support continuous improvement. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform essential functions.

Work environment: Professional, computer-based role involving telephone/video communication and routine use of office equipment. Final physical requirements and job classification are subject to HR review.

89d75f7b08653d62fd21.description:
**Pay:** $82,000 - $88,000 (Depending on experience

**Location:** Remote (U.S.)

**Type:** Full-Time

About Autism Learning Partners

Autism Learning Partners (ALP) is a leading provider of autism and developmental disability services. We are committed to helping children and families achieve meaningful progress through compassionate, high-quality care.

About the Role

Autism Learning Partners is seeking a **Clinician Workforce Operations Specialist** to own the systems, processes, and operational accuracy behind our clinician recruiting efforts.

This hands-on role combines backend ATS administration, recruiting operations, data validation, and continuous process improvement. You'll manage and optimize Paradox workflows, maintain accurate requisition and pipeline data, validate reporting dashboards, and independently troubleshoot operational challenges.

We're looking for someone who brings strong technical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and a track record of turning operational challenges into practical, lasting improvements. This is an individual contributor role with significant ownership and the opportunity to make a measurable impact across our clinician recruiting team.

What You'll Do

**Recruiting Systems & ATS Administration**

* Own backend administration of Paradox, including system configurations, workflows, automations, permissions, templates, and ongoing maintenance.
* Independently configure, test, troubleshoot, and implement approved system changes, including requisition, candidate, and offer-related workflows.
* Partner with internal stakeholders and system vendors to resolve technical issues, optimize system functionality, and improve the recruiter and candidate experience.

**Recruiting Operations & Data Integrity**

* Manage daily clinician recruiting operations, including requisition updates, job postings, and maintenance of the Clinical Recruiting Breakdown (CRB).
* Maintain accurate candidate pipeline data, recruiting records, and operational trackers, including stages, dispositions, and candidate aging.
* Own ongoing maintenance and validation of existing Databricks dashboards, partnering with analytics on technical fixes.
* Reconcile data across Paradox, the CRB, Excel, and reporting tools to identify discrepancies and ensure accurate leadership reporting.

**Operational Audits & Continuous Improvement**

* Conduct recurring audits of requisitions, job postings, recruiting data, and workflows to identify risks and process-compliance gaps.
* Independently investigate operational challenges, recommend solutions, and implement approved improvements from testing through rollout.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, trackers, and training resources, leveraging technology and approved AI tools to improve efficiency.
* Partner with recruiting leadership and the BT Talent Acquisition Operations Specialist to align processes, reporting standards, and cross-team coverage.

What We're Looking For

* **3+ years of experience** in Talent Acquisition, recruiting operations, or ATS administration.
* **Demonstrated experience independently configuring, testing, troubleshooting, and maintaining ATS workflows, automations, permissions, and system settings.**
* **Advanced Excel proficiency**, including XLOOKUP or comparable formulas, PivotTables, data validation, and reconciliation.
* Experience validating and interpreting dashboards using Databricks, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. SQL is not required.
* Proven experience conducting operational audits, developing SOPs, and implementing process improvements.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to identify issues, recommend solutions, and follow through independently.
* Exceptional attention to detail, organization, accountability, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Paradox (Olivia) or administration of a comparable ATS.
* Experience in healthcare, ABA, behavioral health, or multi-site recruiting operations.
* Experience supporting ATS implementations, system configurations, or workflow testing.
* Familiarity with Databricks, Power BI, or basic SQL.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field preferred but not required.

Why This Role Matters

Behind every successful clinician hire is an operation that needs to run smoothly. This role ensures our recruiting team has accurate information, reliable systems, and efficient processes to bring qualified clinicians to the children and families who need them.

**If you're someone who sees a problem, finds a solution, and takes pride in making things work better, we'd love to hear from you!**

*Autism Learning Partners supports a diverse workforce and is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

***Join Immatics and shape*** ***the future*** ***of cancer immunotherapy;*** ***one patient at a time!***

Immatics is committed to making a meaningful impact on the lives of patients with cancer. We are the global leader in precision targeting of **PRAME**, a target expressed in more than 50 cancers. Our cutting-edge science and robust clinical pipeline form the broadest **PRAME** franchise with the most **PRAME** indications and modalities, spanning TCR T-cell therapies and TCR bispecifics.

The **Director, Team Lead, Site Operations** is the formal people leader and functional process owner for assigned Site Operations personnel within Clinical Operations. The role is accountable for line management, resource planning, capability development, functional quality, and the design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of designated Site Operations and Clinical Operations processes. The Team Lead enables consistent, compliant execution across Germany and the United States and partners closely with Clinical Operations Leads to ensure appropriately skilled resources are assigned to studies.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of clinical monitoring experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including roles as a Clinical Research Associate and/or Clinical Trial Manager.

* Strong working knowledge of ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and global clinical trial requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders across multiple organizational levels.
* Proven experience managing resources, priorities, and competing business demands in a dynamic environment.
* History of driving operational improvements and implementing innovative approaches within Clinical Operations.
* Experience supporting regulatory inspections and audit readiness activities.

**In** **this Role You Will:**

People Leadership and Talent Development

* Create an environment of trust, accountability, inclusion, and psychological safety while addressing performance or conduct concerns promptly and appropriately.
* Ensure team members maintain the training, qualifications, competencies, and functional knowledge required for their assigned responsibilities.

Resource and Capacity Management

* Maintain visibility of team capacity, capabilities, workload, and development needs; lead resource forecasting and cross-study workload balancing in consultation with the Head of Clinical Operations.
* Assign or reassign Site Operations personnel to studies based on portfolio priorities, required competencies, workload, continuity needs, and development opportunities, in consultation with the relevant Clinical Operations Leads.

Functional Process Ownership and Operational Excellence

* Own, develop, maintain, and harmonize designated Site Operations and Clinical Operations processes, SOPs, work instructions, guidance documents, templates, and training materials in partnership with relevant stakeholders and Quality.

Quality, Compliance, and Site Operations Expertise

* Model transparent communication, reliable execution, sound judgment, and collaborative leadership across the global Clinical Operations organization.

* A recruiter-facilitated introduction and interview with the hiring leader and key stakeholders (via video)

**On-Site Location:** Nephrology & Hypertension Associates, 370 Middletown Boulevard, #504, Langhorne, PA 19047

Are you looking for a role that:

* You can earn above average income based on work ethic and efficiency?
* Is a hybrid position allowing work from home opportunities?
* Is less stressful than a typical hands-on healthcare job? (Not on your feet, mostly desk work).
* Offers promotion opportunities at an aggressively growing company?
* Provides all the training and support you need to be successful

If so, we are hiring for CMA, CCMA, or LPN's. The role involves onboarding patients into our VCM (Virtual Care Management) program, and performing patient monitoring activities. This is a hybrid opportunity: you must be able to work on-site at Nephrology & Hypertension Associates (370 Middletown Boulevard, #504, Langhorne, PA 19047) for 8 hours a day at least 3 days a week, with the remaining time worked remotely. We are looking for people who can commit to 25 to 40 hours a week and who live no more than a 30-minute commute from this location.

Vironix Health is one the fastest growing Ai-health technology companies across the globe with cutting edge virtual care management (VCM) technologies that provide invaluable preventative care to patients with coronary, respiratory, and kidney diseases. Our comprehensive, flagship product provides Remote Physiologic Monitoring (RPM), and Complex Chronic Care Management (CCCM) services to physician practices for enhanced patient care and significant new revenue generation. We further provide cellular-enabled devices, software, mobile apps, and monitoring staff to support patients and improve outcomes while reducing healthcare costs and hospitalizations.

How You Get Paid — 3 Buckets

Contractors earn $24–$32/hour on average. Top MAs can earn as much as $40/hour. Monthly paychecks typically range from $3,000–$7,000/month.

Bucket 1 – Remote Patient Monitoring (70–95% of pay)

* Conduct scheduled virtual check-ins with patients (weekly or monthly) to follow up on symptoms and medications
* Respond to software alerts when vital sign anomalies are detected (e.g., dangerously high blood pressure)
* Can be done from home (8 AM–5 PM) or on-site

Bucket 2 – Patient Enrollment (On-Site) | $15 per enrolled patient

* Be present at the doctor's office at least 3 days/week to enroll patients in the RPM program
* When a patient comes in, you have ~10 minutes to introduce the program and walk them through enrollment
* Real-time access to the patient schedule — you always know what your day looks like
* Submit your preferred on-site days weeks in advance (3–5 days); the team schedules around your availability

Bucket 3 – On-Site Hourly Base | $7.25/hour

* Clock in/out during on-site hours — covers commute time and gas
* During downtime between enrollments, continue remote monitoring from a dedicated contractor station — earning from all 3 buckets simultaneously

Requirements

* CMA, CCMA or LPN Certification / License
* Medical Assisting and Patient Care skills
* Knowledge of Medical Terminology
* Experience in Medical Office procedures
* Experience in taking vital sign and weight measures
* Proficiency in managing Medical Records
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and in a team
* Ability to commit to 25 to 40 hours a week
* Ability to work on-site at 370 Middletown Boulevard, #504, Langhorne, PA 19047 for 8 hours a day at least 3 days a week
* Live no more than a 30-minute commute from the on-site location (370 Middletown Boulevard, #504, Langhorne, PA 19047)
* Professional dress appropriate for a medical office
* Ability to maintain a high level of attendance
* Experience with virtual care technologies is a plus

Benefits

* Hybrid role: at least 3 days on-site (8 hours each), remaining time remote
* Flexibility with scheduling on-site
* Performance-driven: The # of patients monitored & work you complete will determine how much money you can make (there is no cap)

Independent Contractor Details

This is a 1099 contractor position, and we are looking for people who can commit to 25 to 40 hours a week. That means:

* You supply your own laptop, home Wi-Fi, and vehicle for commuting
* No employer-provided health insurance or PTO
* Pay schedule: Once a month, on the second Friday of the month

aa6d2a45b022b4aa6b83.title: Collection Site Coordinator – Drug & Alcohol Testing Network Operations
aa6d2a45b022b4aa6b83.description:
**About Affinity eHealth**

Affinity eHealth is a leading Third-Party Administrator (TPA) of drug and alcohol testing services, specializing in the Professional Health Monitoring market. We support professional monitoring programs across North America, providing comprehensive testing administration, collection site management, and technology solutions that help programs effectively monitor participant compliance.

Central to our operations is an extensive North American network of specimen collection sites that provides convenient, reliable, and professional collection services to individuals participating in monitoring programs.

**Position Overview**

Affinity eHealth is seeking a **Collection Site Coordinator** to join our Customer Care team.

Reporting to the Manager of Customer Care, the Collection Site Coordinator will play a key role in the ongoing management, development, and optimization of Affinity's collection site network.

The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing and maintaining relationships with collection site providers, expanding network coverage, negotiating pricing, coordinating collection procedures, and resolving operational issues.

This position requires strong organizational, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, together with an understanding of specimen collection procedures and the operational requirements of drug and alcohol testing programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Collection Site Network Management & Development**

* Support the day-to-day management and administration of Affinity's North American collection site network.
* Identify, evaluate, and recruit new collection sites to expand network coverage and address geographic service gaps.
* Maintain relationships with existing collection site providers, including independent collection facilities and larger national and regional provider organizations.
* Negotiate collection service pricing, fee schedules, and service arrangements with providers to ensure competitive pricing and cost-effective network operations.
* Monitor collection site availability, geographic coverage, service capabilities, and performance to ensure the network continues to meet client and participant needs.
* Manage relationships and operational activities involving FormFox Marketplace, and other third-party collection site networks.
* Identify opportunities to improve network accessibility, efficiency, and service quality.

**Collection Protocols, Training & Quality Assurance**

* Develop, document, and maintain collection protocols and procedural instructions specific to Affinity's client and program requirements.
* Communicate collection requirements to participating sites and provide training and guidance on applicable procedures.
* Ensure collection sites understand and follow the appropriate specimen collection, documentation, chain-of-custody, and specimen shipping procedures.
* Coordinate with collection sites to address procedural deficiencies, collection errors, and other service quality concerns.
* Assist in the investigation and resolution of collection-related incidents, participant complaints, and operational issues.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen collection site reliability, consistency, and service quality.

**Operational Support & Coordination**

* Work closely with Affinity's Customer Care and Account Management teams to address collection site requirements and resolve client or participant service issues.
* Assist in identifying suitable collection locations for participants with specific geographic, scheduling, or collection requirements.
* Coordinate with collection site providers to resolve issues involving missed collections, site availability, collection procedures, and service disruptions.
* Support the Finance team in researching and resolving collection site invoicing, billing discrepancies, payment inquiries, and pricing issues.
* Maintain accurate and current collection site information within Affinity's proprietary SPECTRUM platform, including contact information, locations, operating hours, collection capabilities, negotiated pricing, and other operational details.
* Prepare and maintain network-related documentation, provider records, and operational reports.
* Collaborate with internal teams to identify process improvements and opportunities to enhance the overall collection site experience for clients and participants.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience in the drug and alcohol testing industry, particularly in collection site network management, specimen collection operations, or Third-Party Administration.
* Familiarity with urine, oral fluid, hair, and other specimen collection methods and associated chain-of-custody procedures.
* Experience working with national or regional specimen collection providers, laboratories, or collection site management networks.
* Knowledge of both regulated and non-regulated drug testing environments, including the distinct requirements of professional monitoring programs.
* Experience negotiating pricing, managing vendor relationships, or coordinating service provider networks.
* Familiarity with collection management platforms, including FormFox or similar systems, would be an asset.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong interpersonal and relationship management skills, with the ability to establish effective working relationships with external providers and internal teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Effective negotiation and problem-solving skills.
* A proactive, resourceful, and customer-service-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to learn proprietary software and database systems.
* Sound judgment and professionalism when handling sensitive information and resolving service-related issues.

**Why Join Affinity eHealth?**

Affinity eHealth operates in a specialized and growing industry, providing essential services that support professional accountability, public safety, and the successful participation of individuals in professional monitoring programs.

As a Collection Site Coordinator, you will have the opportunity to:

* Play a meaningful role in the development and management of an extensive North American collection network.
* Build relationships with a diverse range of collection providers and industry partners.
* Contribute directly to improvements in network efficiency, accessibility, and service quality.
* Work collaboratively with an experienced team in a specialized healthcare services environment.
* Help strengthen the infrastructure that supports Affinity's continued growth and commitment to client service.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates are invited to submit their résumé and a brief cover letter outlining their relevant experience, particularly in specimen collection operations, collection network management, or drug and alcohol testing services.

Affinity eHealth is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an inclusive and respectful workplace.

Pay: $40,000.00 - $60,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

**Description**

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action- and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and helping them reach their potential. A&M is different by design: we give people ownership and impact from day one, fuel development through real opportunity, and provide direct access to leaders who invest in our growth. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact clients and shape our industry. Guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, our collaborative, globally minded environment is why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

The Healthcare Industry Group, a subsidiary of A&M, leads transformational change in healthcare. As established leaders and trusted advisors, we deliver results for healthcare executives, boards, private equity firms, investors, law firms, and government agencies. Our team brings diverse perspectives and experiences to assist clients with enhancing financial and operational performance, accelerating strategic growth, and optimizing value throughout the investment lifecycle.

We provide specialized services in interim management, restructuring, revenue cycle management, M&A, compliance, digital technology, and analytics. Our professionals collaborate with a wide range of organizations, including health systems, physician groups, medical schools, behavioral health institutes, managed care organizations, healthcare investors, medical device companies, and suppliers, as well as vision centers, dental practices, and laboratories.

A practice within the Healthcare Industry Group (HIG), the Human Capital and Workforce Management practice is comprised of knowledgeable workforce management and human resources professionals experienced in the healthcare space. This team leads transformational work to meet client goals in a rapidly evolving and dynamic labor market that includes post-transaction integration, organizational design, alignment of staffing to business strategy and demand, change management, workforce cost takeout, and development of talent acquisition, employee engagement and management strategies.

As part of the Human Capital and Workforce Management team, you will have the opportunity to work with clients in a variety of sectors including: health systems and providers, physician groups, ancillary providers, medical schools, vision, laboratory, dental and behavioral health, managed care and health plans, government plans and programs, healthcare investors and lenders, medical devices, healthcare suppliers and infrastructure, life sciences, pharma, and biotech.

**How you will contribute**

As a Senior Associate, you will play a key role on project teams serving as a trusted partner to clients within the healthcare industry. You will be responsible for supporting and managing key workstreams, performing data-driven analyses, developing insights and recommendations, and contributing to the design and implementation of workforce and human capital transformation initiatives. Senior Associates are expected to work independently, communicate effectively, and collaborate closely with team members and client stakeholders. Depending on the client engagement, your responsibilities may include:

* Supporting the design and implementation of organizational and workforce transformation initiatives across a range of healthcare clients
* Managing discrete project workstreams, ensuring progress against goals, deadlines, and deliverables
* Conducting research, quantitative analyses, and qualitative interviews to identify performance improvement opportunities
* Developing client-ready deliverables such as presentations, reports, and dashboards that clearly communicate findings and recommendations
* Partnering with client leaders and team members to identify priorities and execute high-impact solutions under tight timelines
* Collaborating with project managers and Directors to monitor engagement economics, deliverables, and client expectations
* Assisting in the development of key performance indicators (KPIs), benchmarking tools, and analytics to measure workforce efficiency and outcomes
* Contributing to the identification and resolution of root causes for workforce management issues through data-driven insights and practical recommendations
* Participating in proposal development, client presentations, and business development activities as needed
* Contributing to team culture by fostering collaboration, learning, and inclusion across all engagements

At Alvarez & Marsal, you will join an entrepreneurial and collaborative team known for delivering hands-on, results-driven solutions that create meaningful and sustainable change.

We are seeking a motivated, adaptable, and analytical professional with a passion for healthcare and workforce transformation. The ideal candidate is comfortable managing ambiguity, balancing multiple priorities, and driving initiatives to completion in a fast-paced environment.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of six (6) years of progressive experience in Human Resources, Workforce Management, or related areas within the healthcare industry
* Minimum of two (2) to three (3) years of experience in a healthcare consulting environment
* Bachelor’s degree required; master’s degree in human resources, Organizational Development, Business (MBA), Healthcare Administration (MHA), or Public Health (MPH) preferred
* Working knowledge of the healthcare industry, including understanding of healthcare operations, workforce strategy, and labor market dynamics
* Experience supporting or managing initiatives such as workforce planning, staffing-to-demand analysis, organizational design, or HR transformation
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to synthesize findings into actionable insights
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare client-ready materials and present findings to project stakeholders
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word; experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Action O-I benchmarking, or MGMA survey data is a plus
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate within cross-functional teams and contribute to a positive, inclusive, and high-performance work environment
* Willingness and ability to travel as required

**Your journey at A&M**

At A&M, professional growth is tied directly to performance, not tenure. Our people take on meaningful, hands-on work supported by a performance development process that rewards contribution and fosters a culture of meritocracy. Stretch roles, evolving business needs, and firm growth create ongoing opportunities for ownership and building new skills, while direct access to senior leaders provides mentorship and real-time coaching along the way. We also prioritize your wellbeing through comprehensive benefits and resources. Together, these elements create an environment where high-performing professionals can continue to grow and advance from day one.

Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k)-retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k)-retirement savings plan from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part-time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A&M’s benefits programs.

*The salary range is $140,000- $160,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.*

Alvarez & Marsal recruits on an ongoing basis. Candidates are considered as they apply, until the opportunity is filled. Candidates are encouraged to apply expeditiously to any role(s) that they are qualified for and that are of interest to them.

A&M does not require or administer lie detector tests as a condition of employment or continued employment. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

95fd226841fcd1a07f12.title: Engineering Operations Technician, DCC Communities
95fd226841fcd1a07f12.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.
  
  
Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.
  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
  
  
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
* Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
* Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
* Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
* Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
* Technical writing to support change management program
* Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
* On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
* Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
* Role may support more than one location/site.

  
Physical Requirements:  

* Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
* Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
* Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
* Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
* Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
* Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

  
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
  
  
Essential Requirements:
  
  

* Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

  

* Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

  

* Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

  
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.
  
  
A day in the life  
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion of events fosters stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
* 2+ years of electrical and mechanical experience
* Ability to work on a flexible schedule including days, nights, and/or weekends.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working in a data center or mission critical facility (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.)
* Associate or higher education in related field
* Experience with reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

dad9560773acb15a64c9.title: Project Manager 3, National Enterprise Ethernet, Comcast Business
dad9560773acb15a64c9.description:
Comcast Business offers a suite of Connectivity, Communications, Networking, Cybersecurity, Wireless, and Managed Solutions to help global organizations of all sizes prepare for what’s next. Powered by the nation’s largest Gig-speed broadband network and backed by 24/7 customer support, Comcast Business is the nation’s largest technology provider to small businesses and one of the leading service providers to the Enterprise market. Comcast Business has been consistently recognized by industry analysts and associations as a leader and innovator, and one of the fastest growing providers of Ethernet services.  
**Job Summary**

Comcast Business is seeking a highly-driven Project Manager 3 to support our National Enterprise Ethernet portfolio. This role is responsible for managing complex customer deployments, ensuring on-time delivery, and providing exceptional customer experience across large enterprise implementations. This PM3 serves as the central point of coordination and accountability for end-to-end project execution, driving collaboration across cross-functional teams while managing multiple high-visibility customer initiatives. The successful candidate will manage deployments including Ethernet Private Line (EPL), Ethernet Virtual Private Line (EVPL), Ethernet Network Service (ENS), Dedicated Internet, Retail Wavelength, Managed Wi-Fi, and other strategic National Enterprise Ethernet solutions for large enterprise customers. Strong Smartsheet expertise is critical for project tracking, reporting, workflow automation, and executive-level visibility. Due to this team’s present business operations, we are only able to consider candidates who presently reside within Colorado, Pennsylvania, Georgia, Ohio or Illinois, with reasonable proximity to one of the team’s primary hub locations (Denver, Philadelphia, Atlanta, West Chester or Naperville).

**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage project timelines and SLA commitments for National Enterprise Ethernet product deployments, ensuring on-time delivery.
* Coordinate implementation of EPL, EVPL, ENS, Dedicated Internet, Retail Wavelength, Managed Wi-Fi, and other National Enterprise Ethernet services**.**
* Utilize Smartsheet to track project milestones, manage dependencies, automate workflows, and provide real-time visibility to stakeholders.
* Identify, escalate, and mitigate risks impacting customer delivery timelines.
* Drive accountability across cross-functional teams including Sales, Engineering, Service Assurance, Construction, Order Management, and Field Operations.
* Meet and exceed KPI performance metrics while supporting continuous process improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate installation, testing, turn-up, and customer acceptance activities for Enterprise Ethernet services.
* Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure customer communication throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support deployment of new technologies and process enhancements aligned with business objectives and customer requirements.
* Consistently exercise independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent, and punctual attendance.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Key Qualifications:**

* Advanced proficiency in Smartsheet, including dashboards, automation, reporting, and portfolio management.
* Strong understanding of National Enterprise Ethernet products, deployment standards, and implementation workflows.
* Experience managing large enterprise customer deployments involving multiple sites and complex network solutions.
* Proven ability to independently solve complex problems and manage competing priorities.
* Excellent communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated success delivering high-quality customer experiences in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to drive accountability, influence cross-functional teams, and deliver results.

**Customer & Employee Experience:**

* This role is critical to delivering a best-in-class customer experience by ensuring timely, high-quality National Enterprise Ethernet implementations, proactive communication, and transparent project tracking through tools like Smartsheet. Maintaining appropriate staffing levels also supports a strong employee experience by balancing workloads, reducing burnout, and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

**Disclaimer:**

* This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
