### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
  
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let's advance the world of minimally invasive care.

### **Job Description**

* **Please note: Candidates must live within or be willing to relocate to the Rochester, NY Area to perform the duties of this role.**

**Primary Function of Position**  
The DaVinci Specialist (DVS) will provide expert clinical & technical support, build, customize and coordinate education & training to physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on the use of DaVinci surgery, devices and therapies. This role partners closely with the sales team, specifically the Clinical Sales Representative and Clinical Sales Manager, to ensure safe and effective product adoption and quality control while driving positive patient outcomes.

The DaVinci Specialist is a dedicated program execution & clinical education partner for hospitals running a da Vinci robotic surgery program. Based on its expertise, this role focuses on identifies and tailors the nature and extent of staff in-servicing, day-to-day program execution, technology onboarding and operational support, communicating identified needs to hospital OR operations and leadership. The DVS will work alongside the daVinci Clinical Sales Representative .

**Essential Job Duties**

**Collaboration & Field Partnership (Within a CSM Team)**

* Partner with the local CSR/CSM and cross-functional business partners to create, own, scale and execute best practices and deployment of ecosystem resources.
* Lead account support plans that drive safe program execution and increase customer autonomy over time, including setting objectives, timelines and resources for relevant customers, in consultation with CSR/CSM.
* Identify, solicit and provide field feedback and customer insights to internal teams to improve training, support resources, and customer experience.
* Support adoption of digital solutions by helping customers build comfort and capability through in-servicing and troubleshooting.

**Clinical & Technical Support**

* Identify and provide on-site, non-scrubbed operating room support for procedures utilizing the da Vinci Surgical System and associated technologies.

* Support OR teams with room readiness and procedural workflow, including system setup support, docking workflow support, and intraoperative troubleshooting.
* Serve as a clinical product expert to help ensure optimal, safe system use and adherence to applicable IFUs, hospital policies, and safety protocols.
* Motivate and support adoption of advanced instruments and accessories by ensuring teams understand proper setup, handling, and intended use.

* Partner with and promote consistent readiness and workflow by supporting day-to-day execution of the robotic program, coordinating with OR leadership, nursing, SPD/sterile processing, and biomedical teams.
* Assist with operational support activities such as facilitating appropriate internal handoffs for service needs.
* Ensure the right stakeholders are aligned (OR, SPD, biomed, IT) for successful day-to-day operation and new technology onboarding to help reduce friction.
* Maintain accurate internal documentation of support activities per company process (e.g., case support notes, training records, service/escalation tracking).

**Training & Education (Care Team Enablement)**

* Determine the need for, customize and deliver customer-specific hands-on training and in-services to nurses, surgical technologists, SPD teams, and other care team members on safe and effective use of da Vinci platforms and associated technologies.
* Support onboarding and education for new users through structured training touchpoints (e.g., new staff orientation, refresher training, workflow standardization).
* Lead new site start-ups by identifying and delivering onboarding programs and coordinating training logistics with the CSR/CSM and hospital stakeholders.
* Support new technology installs by coordinating readiness activities and providing post-install education to care teams.
* Act as a resource for ongoing education, product updates, and workflow optimization.

**Escalation & Customer Issue Management**

* Analyze and leverage utilization, turnover, and other relevant case data to recommend operational changes to customers
* Provide first-line support and expertise for common setup and workflow issues during live cases and training sessions.
* Identify, resolve and where necessary escalate issues appropriately to internal partners (e.g., Technical Support, Field Service, Clinical/Medical counterparts).

**Market & Clinical Insights**

* Collect and communicate customer feedback *and experiences* to clinical counterparts and internal business partners. Prioritizing, distilling and reporting relevant customer feedback, in real time.
* Stay up to date on clinical literature, competitive products, and evolving treatment guidelines.
* Assist in clinical trial support when required.
* Assist in field action activities when necessary.

### **Qualifications**

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Experience: 2+ years in an operating room-related role
* Clinical experience is preferred.
* Experience as a robotics coordinator, surgical assistant, and/or surgical nurse plus industry experience strongly preferred.
* Understanding of soft tissue anatomy & procedures.
* Exhibit a working knowledge of typical hospital policies.
* Excellent communication, teaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work in high-pressure environments (managing multiple ORs) and coordination of multiple tasks at one time.
* Adaptability to evolving technologies and complex procedures.
* Team oriented with a commercial mindset.
* Willingness to travel up to 40%. Primary travel will be within a CSM team.
* Ability to travel within a Clinical Sales Manager team geography, supporting multiple hospitals.
* Flexibility to support early starts, after-hours cases, and weekend procedures based on customer need and territory utilization.

**Required Education and Training**

* Associates degree. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Degrees in (RN, PA, NP, RT, or other clinical credentials) are welcomed.

**Working Conditions**

* Ability to stand for extended periods and provide in-person case support within an operating room (OR) environment, which includes pushing, pulling, lifting and squatting.

We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay + CIP, benefits, and equity. The target pay rate for this position is:

### **Who We Are**

KPA helps automotive businesses keep their people safe, protect their operations, and stay ahead of regulatory change with our 3 Pillars for Complete Compliance: Software, Consulting, and Training. Since 1986, KPA has helped automotive businesses navigate the complexities of compliance.  
  
Named as one of Built In Colorado’s Best Places to Work for seven years in a row, KPA is made up of talented individuals working together for the greater good. We’re here to help our clients build safe, thriving organizations, and we’re looking for people with a common goal to help us do it.

**Position Description:**

The role of the Technical Support Specialist is to assist customers who are experiencing any procedural or operating difficulty with the use of KPA’s software applications, products or services. Complex and/or high priority problems are elevated to specialized support groups for resolution when needed, but the Technical Support Specialist is responsible to ensure that an effective solution is provided to the user.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Assist in troubleshooting and resolution and engage tier 2 technical support when appropriate.
* Prioritize and handle incoming customer support issues and ensure response according to defined standards, documenting all related communication/information into a centralized ticketing system. Address end-user concerns in a competent and professional manner.
* Provide oversight and guidance to KPA’s Clients, Subject Matter Experts, and Partners, and encourage a culture that under promises and over delivers.
* Communicate recurring issues to staff effectively to help foster team cohesion.
* Provide daily review of completed help desk tickets for accuracy and completeness.
* Provide constant feedback toward quality improvements to our solutions and ensuring customer satisfaction.
* Attend and grow from Product or Tier 2 training sessions as required for the handling of new product releases, processes or procedures.
* Become the trusted voice in KPA for customer issue resolution.

### **Success Criteria:**

* You must be responsible, detail-oriented and conscientious. Your commitment to the customer and to the proper handling of their issues is of utmost importance.
* Very strong knowledge of computer technology as it relates to the real world.
* You should have the ability to make people comfortable with KPA’s technology and mission.
* Become a trusted voice for KPA customers, clients and partners from a customer success perspective.
* Familiarity with both the Windows and Mac operating systems.
* Capability to multi-task and address changing priorities is a must. Must possess strong organizational skills and be able to plan, organize, and track tasks for successful resolution.
* Generally two years’ experience solving computer problems.
* Certifications and technical degrees are desirable. Familiarity with compliance regulations is a plus.
* Of greatest importance is that you possess a commitment to guiding the issue to resolution – whether by yourself or by engaging escalation points within the client success organization.
* Excellent verbal and written communication ability, being able to discuss and explain technical issues in non-technical terms to which a customer can relate.

### **Communication Skills:**

* This position requires handling information in an appropriate manner. Customer interactions must be handled with diplomacy and tact. Individual must be able to gauge the customer's technical ability and communicate with them in appropriate technical or non-technical language in a non-condescending manner.

### **Success Criteria:**

* Self-Directed work habits with the ability to manage time and schedule effectively.
* Must be able to learn and support new and fast-changing technologies.
* Excellent interpersonal and team-oriented skills.
* Good work habits under pressure and the ability to “think on your feet”.
* Highly proficient with the use of MS Office applications and similar software tool.
* Ability to effectively engage with customers in an energetic and up-beat manner.
* Detail oriented.
* Must have a good command of the English language in order to provide effective phone, chat, and email support.

### **Compensation**

* Compensation Rate: $22-26 per hour
* Annual bonus potential up to 7.5%

### **Physical Requirements**

Physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Visual Recognition - Constantly
* Stationary sitting or standing position - Constantly
* Working at a computer typing and view a screen - Constantly
* Speaking, Hearing, and Listening - Often

Studies have shown some people are less likely to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you’re excited about the role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply! You might just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

As a growing company KPAvalues its employees by supporting them with a full benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, PTO, Paid and Floating Holidays, 401k with Company match and immediate vesting, Company-funded Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Programs, and No-cost Mental Health Benefits.

a79864aeb8aaab58e82d.description:
Sono Bello is America's top cosmetic surgery specialist, with 185+ board-certified surgeons who have performed over 300,000 laser liposuction and body contouring procedures. A career at Sono Bello means being part of a dynamic and high-energy work environment where every team member can make a difference. We love what we do, and it shows! We believe everyone deserves to have their best body today and pursue their best life now.

* **Applicants must reside in the state of Nevada to be considered for this role.**

Do you like talking to people? Are you warm, empathetic, and enjoy helping others? Do you also have strong sales experience to successfully navigate through sensitive conversations?

As the industry leaders, we proudly offer an exceptional patient experience and seek dynamic team members who are committed to working toward that same standard. **Sono Bello is currently hiring Patient Ambassadors!** We are looking for the best of the best, and will extend competitive compensation, benefits, and a bonus program with opportunities for growth and development.

We specialize in micro-laser assisted liposuction and total body transformation – it is all we do! Our surgeons are highly trained in micro-laser technology and perform thousands of body contouring procedures every year. Although there are many different providers for liposuction, none offer the same combination of expertise, innovation, dependability, and affordability as Sono Bello.

Patient Ambassadors are responsible for creating the first impression in the patient journey and setting the stage by scheduling a free consultation via phone, sms, live chat and email. Although our primary role is to schedule consultations at our conveniently located consult centers and fully accredited surgical centers across the United States; we also work directly with center team members, clinicians, and surgeons to support our existing patients. This is including, but not limited to: sending patient requests for follow up, warm-transferring to the center and fielding non-urgent, urgent, and emergent Medical Escalations to connect patients with clinicians or an On-Call Surgeon. All while adhering to our Quality Assurance requirements!

You must be a self-starter and a highly motivated professional. Please prepare to share your work experience, where you have demonstrated your ability to meet and exceed targets. Although you work in cooperation with an amazing team of Patient Ambassadors, this position is remote and will ultimately rely on your individual performance.

We are grateful for the opportunity to welcome new Patient Ambassadors to join the industry leaders! Moreover, we are committed to helping our patients live their lives beautifully and intend to offer the same opportunities for our team members.

**BENEFITS:**

* Full time hours only
* Consistent schedule with a variety of shift options
* 3-4 weeks of paid training
* Base pay of $16.00-$18.00/HR + monthly bonuses
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
* 401K investing program
* Paid holidays
* Paid time off
* Remote work environment
* Career coaching toward professional growth and development

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Welcome new patients via inbound call, outbound call, sms, live chat, and email to schedule a free consultation (no cold calling). *Must be very tech savvy, with the ability to navigate multiple systems on your PC efficiently.*
* Support existing patients by sending requests for follow up, warm-transferring to the center and fielding non-urgent, urgent, and emergent Medical Escalations to connect patients with center team members, clinicians, or an On-Call Surgeon.
* Accurately capture and enter patient information with detailed notes within our CRM systems
* Adhere to compliance with call flow, candidacy, light medical screening questions, and all other Quality Assurance requirements
* Own the first impression of the patient journey
* Engage with patients, build rapport, and offer support in finding solutions by overcoming objections
* Collaborate with Leadership, Training and QA to stay updated on new services and policies

**IMPORTANT ATTRIBUTES:**

* Enjoy speaking with and helping patients
* Be confident with technology
* Must have sales experience or strong communication skills to navigate sensitive conversations
* Be a self-starter, motivated and driven to advance your skill set while meeting and exceeding targets
* Thrive in a remote, work from home setting
* Highly reliable and able to maintain exemplary attendance

**ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS (REQUIRED):**

* Customer service: 1 year
* Sales with a quota or objective: 1 year
* You must have a flexible schedule with the ability to work at least 1 weekend day on a regular basis. *PAC Team Members will earn a weekend hourly pay differential on Saturday and Sundays.*
* You must have the ability to establish a private workspace with a lockable door for your home workstation; your PC equipment will be provided for you. *Due to patient privacy, other people, friends, and family members are not permitted to be in the room with you while you work (regardless of age).*
* You must have the ability to perform basic technical troubleshooting and maintenance.
* No background noises
* High-speed internet connection. Have a high-speed internet connection that is adequate for the job. (At least 100 Mbps is needed for optimal performance). Not recommended, Wireless based internet service (Satellite/Cellular/Microwave)
* Ability to pass typing and additional skill assessment. At least (40WPM, 95% accuracy).

The hiring process will include a combination of phone, virtual and a skills assessment.

be0d8f7f3a81ab1e6aab.title: Customer Success Associate
be0d8f7f3a81ab1e6aab.description:
**Customer Success Associate**

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers.

The Customer Success Associate (CSA) is a high-velocity, quota-carrying role that drives expansion revenue by selling into an assigned book of existing Fullbay customers.

Success depends on a high volume of phone calls and live conversations: CSAs uncover business problems, quantify the value of additional Fullbay products and services, and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities through consultative, value-based selling, while protecting retention and the customer relationship.

**The Right Wrench for the Job**

In a heavy-duty shop, the best service advisor doesn't just write up what the customer asked for. They know the fleet, notice the unit that is overdue for service, and explain what the repair will save in downtime and cost, so the owner can say yes with confidence. That is the instinct this role calls for: you look closely at a customer's shop, find the opportunity that helps it run better, and back it with a clear business case.

You're the right fit if you are energized by a full day of live conversations, ask sharp discovery questions, and stay disciplined about your pipeline, forecast, and notes in Salesforce and ChurnZero. You handle objections and pricing conversations without losing the relationship, and you hold yourself to daily activity targets and monthly revenue goals. This isn't the role for someone who prefers email to the phone or wants a book of accounts to simply maintain. If you want to earn your results one conversation at a time while helping customers get more from Fullbay, we'd like to talk.

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Own and grow an assigned book of existing customers by identifying, qualifying, and closing upsell, cross-sell, and add-on opportunities that increase recurring revenue.
* Run a high volume of outbound and inbound phone calls and live conversations each day, using calls as the primary channel and email, chat, and video to support them.
* Lead value-based conversations: discover business challenges, quantify the financial impact of Fullbay solutions, and build a clear business case tied to the customer's shop performance.
* Build and work a prioritized pipeline from account data, usage and health signals, and customer segment insights, targeting the accounts most likely to expand.
* Manage the full sales cycle on expansion deals, from first conversation through demo, proposal, negotiation, and close, in a short, fast-moving cycle.
* Handle objections, pricing, and price-increase conversations with confidence, and defend value while protecting the relationship.
* Deliver tailored live demos and walkthroughs of additional functionality that map to the customer's workflow and goals.
* Strengthen retention across the book by driving product adoption, surfacing churn risks early, and addressing root causes of disengagement during sales conversations.
* Identify at-risk and cancellation signals, and route them promptly to CSA, Retention, who owns the save effort, with account history and context.
* Provide consultative guidance on training resources and advanced product functionality, evaluating customer context to recommend the best solution.
* Record all calls, activity, opportunities, forecasts, and customer interactions accurately and in real time in Salesforce and ChurnZero.
* Manage a weekly and monthly forecast, and keep pipeline and next steps current and defensible.
* Hit and sustain daily and weekly activity targets (calls, conversations, demos) and monthly and quarterly expansion revenue goals.
* Test and refine messaging, call talk tracks, and outreach sequencing, and share what works with the team.
* Partner with Digital Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Product, Marketing, and Support to align on offers, pricing, handoffs, and customer needs.
* Share product feedback, competitive insights, success stories, and recurring objections with internal stakeholders to inform product, packaging, and lifecycle planning.
* Contribute to playbooks, call guides, and operating standards for the expansion motion.
* Performance is measured primarily on incremental recurring revenue closed from your assigned book, supported by pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy against monthly and quarterly goals, gross and net revenue retention, timely handling of at-risk accounts, and accurate, timely logging of calls, opportunities, and next steps.

  

***Additional Duties & Responsibilities:***

* Adhere to all confidentiality and compliance regulations
* Perform other duties as assigned

  

**Minimum Education & Work Experience:**

* 2+ years in a quota-carrying or revenue-influencing role such as Account Management, Customer Success with expansion goals, Inside Sales, or Business Development (preferably in B2B SaaS).
* Demonstrated success in a high-volume, phone-based environment, with a record of meeting or exceeding activity and revenue targets.
* Experience selling into an existing customer base (upsell, cross-sell, renewal, or add-on) strongly preferred.
* Experience in the trucking, fleet maintenance, heavy-duty repair, or automotive industry is a plus.

  

**Key Skills and Qualifications:**

* Comfort and stamina on the phone: confident making many calls a day, starting conversations with customers, and recovering quickly from rejection.
* Skilled in consultative, value-based selling: asking strong discovery questions, quantifying business impact and ROI, and tying solutions to customer outcomes rather than features.
* Strong objection handling and negotiation skills, including pricing and price-increase conversations.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills across phone, email, video, and chat, with the ability to balance empathy and assertiveness.
* High urgency, self-discipline, and ownership: manages time and priorities independently across a large book of accounts.
* Coachable and driven by goals, with a track record of using feedback, call reviews, and data to improve.
* Experience navigating and leveraging CRM and customer systems (Salesforce, ChurnZero, Gainsight, Zendesk, etc.), with disciplined forecasting and pipeline hygiene.
* Ability to read customer health, usage, and churn signals to prioritize outreach and spot opportunity and risk.
* Familiarity with subscription-based business models and metrics such as MRR, ARR, NRR, and GRR is a plus.

  

**Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
* Spends a significant portion of the day on the phone and on video calls, with extended periods of speaking and listening.
* Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening.
* Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
* Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
* Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor, and operate a cell phone or a computer-based phone.

  

**Compensation:**

*$55,000.00 base + $23,571.43 OTC* = $78,571.43 OTE per year

Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

**Job Summary**

Reporting to and working under the general direction of the Manager, the teammates in Patient Billing Solutions (PBS) review and resolve guarantor account balances. Contact with guarantors can be either inbound contacts or outbound contacts that are generated by phone, written correspondence, email or secure Epic in-basket requests. Primary focus includes timely responses to guarantor inquiries generally matching the method that was used to contact PBS.
  
  
Account resolution takes many forms including securing payments, making appropriate adjustments, initiating reviews of insurance processing, refunding guarantor balances or resolving a wide range of registration, demographic or insurance coverage issues. Some guarantor accounts will be queued for action due to the account being placed in a Work Queue that is designated for action by a PBS team. Most staff will have some responsibility to answer phone calls via an Automated Call Distribution (ACD) process (i.e. Call Center). This responsibility will vary based on the specific team assignment.  
  
Account resolution typically requires expertise in multiple modules in Epic, including HB Resolute, PB Resolute, Registration/ADT and Credit Specialist training. Broad based knowledge of medical billing and insurance processing is also required. Staff must be able to respond knowledgeably to a wide range of issues for every contracted and non-contracted payer, including government and non-government payers presenting their findings professionally in language that the guarantor can understand. Staff must be diligent in following HIPAA Privacy guidelines.
  
  
The primary goal of PBS is to resolve the guarantor’s concerns focusing on providing excellent customer service that enhances their overall experience with MGB.  
  
  
  
  

* Respond to patient/guarantor/Customer concerns which span a wide range of issues including payer denials, coding accuracy/appropriateness, secondary billing, Coordination of Benefits, verification of co-payments/co-insurance/deductibles and verification/updates to demographic/insurance information and fiscal registrations to verify the patient’s responsibility for all outstanding balances. Verification process routinely includes contacting other departments at MGB/RCO/entities, payers, affiliated physician organizations and other vendors (Collection Agencies and other outsource agents). Representative must be fully versed in MGB
* Credit & Collection Policy and Financial Assistance Policy and must inform patients of all assistance available to them when making payment arrangements, processing payments, application, or referring patients to Financial Counseling.
* Provide timely, professional, and accurate account review, analysis, and resolution of patient inquiries. Whenever possible, resolve issues during the initial telephone call. Verify the patient’s fiscal and demographic information at every opportunity and make appropriate updates to various billing systems to ensure claims are processed appropriately and Medicare as a Secondary Payer questionnaire. Resolve complex issues with minimal external or supervisory involvement. Document all patient interactions and account actions in assigned billing systems to establish a clear audit trail.
* Obtain information from and perform actions on accounts in Epic (HB and PB Resolute) and for selected HB accounts, TRAC and QUIC. Look up information in other support systems as needed including, but not limited to, Legacy Data Access LDA, document imaging (OnBase), eligibility verification systems (NEHEN, payer web sites) and other document backup (Sharepoint) to identify root cause issues. Use systems and information to resolve issues and respond to the patient’s inquiry. Obtain information from internal third-party payer units, intermediaries for professional practices and hospital departments, payers, ambulance companies and other hospitals/Home Health/Rehab Facilities to help resolve the patient’s inquiry.
* Understand liability claims, legal basics, medical terminology, a general knowledge of the MGB

network hospitals including major variations in administrative protocols as well as key industry issues.
  

* Must provide cordial, courteous and high-quality service to callers. Must listens attentively to patients by placing customer concerns ahead of oneself. Understand and practice concern for patients as the ultimate consumers of service.
* Effectively handle all communications, which may include via Work Queues, correspondence, telephone and emails (MGB emails and Patient Gateway/Epic Inbox messages, from patients and other departments within MGB. Utilize customer service, collections, and billing experience to gather and interpret relevant information to resolve patient account issues and complaints.
* Follow through on commitments and achieves desired results. Exhibits sound judgment, obtains the facts, examines options, gains support and achieves positive outcomes.
* Properly document every account that is accessed. Document with clear concise notes.
* Ensure accurate patient billing through review of account history, third party billing activity and analysis of payments and adjustments. Seek expert assistance from other departments such as Coding, Third Party Billing/Follow Up, Revenue Control/Cash Processing, and Group Practice Billing Managers by making appropriate inquiries through established channels.
* Identify root cause(s) of guarantor/patient inquiries and report findings to management for appropriate resolution to future accounts. Follow up on individual issues to assure they are completed. Record and classify all communications in the appropriate systems for statistical reporting.
* Submit patient credit balances that need to be refunded to the appropriate parties for action by verifying the reason for the credit.
* Communicate clearly and concisely both orally and in writing. Follow established regulations and procedures in collection, recording, storage and handling of information. Ensure required documentation of issues is complete, accurate, timely and legible. Protect and preserve confidentiality and integrity of all information according to MGB HIPAA confidentiality policy.
* Supports and demonstrates the values of the MGB and affiliates by conducting activities in an ethical manner with integrity, honesty, and confidentiality. Demonstrates a positive, open-minded, can-do attitude. Represents a team perspective and willingness and enthusiasm to collaborate with others. Enthusiastically promote a cooperative team environment to provide value to all customers. Listen and interact tactfully, diplomatically and effectively without alienating others.
* Follows through on commitments and achieves desired results. Exhibits sound judgment, obtains the facts, examines options, gains support, and achieves positive outcomes.
* Maintain high standards of professional conduct. Comply with the all applicable MGB Patient Billing Solution policies and procedures. Follow department attendance expectations and arrive for work well prepared at the expected time. Attend required training.
* Specific expectations and accountabilities include:
* Consistently answer calls at the average of the daily rate for the team, typically at least 40-50 calls per day.
* To the degree possible, maintain a daily list of all accounts accessed. Provide supervisor/manager with an account listing of all unresolved issues weekly.
* Representative resolves at least 80% of patient issues without referring the call to the supervisor/manager.
* Pass routine quality assurance reviews at an average of >90%
* Performs other duties tasks or projects as assigned. Able to work and think independently while being self-motivated.

**Qualifications**

* High School diploma or GED equivalent required
* Associates Degree preferred but not required
* Epic billing systems knowledge preferred
* Effective communication, organizational and problem-solving skills required.
* 1-3 years relevant experience in customer service or collections in a health care setting strongly desired.
* Alternative work experience or training in lieu of experience may be considered.

**Additional Job Details (if applicable)**

* 20 hours a week, shifts will range M- F between 11:00am-3:00pm EST

Join our vibrant pediatric dental practice as a **Pediatric Dental Receptionist/Office Coordinator,** where your energetic and organized approach will help create a welcoming environment for our young patients and their families. In this vital role, you will be the first point of contact, ensuring smooth daily operations while providing exceptional patient service. Your expertise in dental and medical administrative support will contribute to delivering top-quality care and maintaining efficient office workflows. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to be part of a dynamic team dedicated to improving children's oral health.

**Compensation & Benefits**  
Compensation for the initial 3-month trial period will be discussed during the interview process. Pay will be based on the candidate’s experience, certifications, and overall qualifications. * Greet patients and families warmly, ensuring a positive first impression and smooth check-in/check-out processes

**Position Summary**

The Virtual Training and Compliance Coordinator supports the delivery of OSHA-authorized and workforce development training programs by coordinating virtual classroom operations, participant verification, testing administration, compliance monitoring, outreach activities, and training logistics. This position works closely with instructors, facilitators, students, and administrative staff to ensure a high-quality learning experience while maintaining compliance with OSHA Outreach Training Program requirements, Department of Human Services (DHS) grant requirements, and institutional policies.

The coordinator serves as a virtual proctor for online courses, assists with enrollment growth initiatives for in-person training programs, maintains program data and records, and provides administrative support for learning management systems, Salesforce, LifeLearn, and other training technologies.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

***Virtual Training, Testing, and Compliance***

* Support Virtual Instructor-Led Training (VILT) courses conducted through Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Brightspace, and other approved learning platforms.
* Verify participant identity, attendance, and eligibility for training and testing activities.
* Serve as a proctor for DHS grant-funded and other compliance-based virtual training programs.
* Assist with online testing administration through Brightspace, Respondus, or similar systems.
* Monitor participant engagement, camera compliance, attendance, and testing requirements during live virtual classes.
* Troubleshoot technical issues related to virtual classrooms, testing platforms, and student access.
* Maintain accurate training records, testing results, attendance documentation, and compliance reports.
* Assist with OSHA Outreach Training documentation, course reporting, and audit preparation.

***Training Operations and Instructor Support***

* Assist instructors and VILT facilitators with course preparation, classroom setup, and delivery logistics.
* Coordinate student communications, registration support, and distribution of training materials.
* Manage course schedules, instructor availability, and classroom logistics for virtual and in-person training programs.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for instructor communications regarding scheduling, outreach initiatives, and course administration.
* Support the delivery of engaging and interactive learning experiences through virtual classroom tools and technologies.

***Outreach and Enrollment Development***

* Research and implement outreach strategies to increase enrollment in OSHA, safety, workforce development, and continuing education programs.
* Support marketing and recruitment efforts targeting employers, workforce partners, community organizations, and prospective students.
* Track outreach activities and evaluate enrollment outcomes to identify growth opportunities.

***Data Management and Administrative Support***

* Create, maintain, and analyze spreadsheets and reports related to enrollment, attendance, instructor scheduling, outreach efforts, and program performance.
* Assist with Salesforce data entry, reporting, and customer relationship management activities.
* Support LifeLearn data entry, record maintenance, and reporting functions.
* Prepare operational reports and provide data to support program planning and decision-making.
* Maintain confidential student, instructor, and organizational records in accordance with applicable policies and regulations.

***Required Qualifications***

* Associate degree in business, education, occupational safety, instructional technology, workforce development, or a related field; bachelor's degree preferred.
* Two years of experience supporting virtual learning, workforce training, continuing education, or administrative operations.
* Experience using virtual learning and collaboration platforms such as Brightspace, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or similar technologies.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and data tracking tools.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking abilities.
* Excellent customer service, written communication, and interpersonal skills.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Experience with Salesforce, LifeLearn, Brightspace, Respondus, or online proctoring platforms.
* Experience supporting OSHA Outreach Training programs, workforce development initiatives, or grant-funded training programs.
* Knowledge of OSHA Outreach Training Program requirements and compliance-based training environments.
* Experience with adult education, continuing education, or corporate training operations.

***Key Competencies***

* Virtual Training Support
* Online Test Proctoring and Compliance Monitoring
* Data Analysis and Reporting
* Customer Service and Student Support
* Learning Management Systems Administration
* Instructor Coordination
* Outreach and Enrollment Development
* Technical Troubleshooting

Overview:

University Health Services (UHS) at Princeton University is a fully accredited (Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care, or “AAAHC”) health care facility. Located in the McCosh Health Center, the Caldwell Field House and Dillon Gym, UHS provides comprehensive health services to more than 7,500 Princeton undergraduate and graduate students, and specialized services to Princeton University faculty, staff, and employees who experience work-related injuries and illnesses, or who require consultations regarding international and travel medicine.

UHS hires individuals of all backgrounds. We build on our staff’s diversity-recognizing, valuing, and appreciating the different perspectives, talents and energy of all. UHS invites all its employees to make a valuable contribution in this regard. We firmly believe that being an inclusive and culturally responsive community is one of the foundations of a vibrant, relevant organization. We aspire to develop the mindsets, knowledge and abilities to build equitable and inclusive systems, teams and culture.

**The Administrative Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the daily front-desk operations of the Occupational Health office and serves as a key administrative and operational resource for the department. This position manages departmental budgets and expense tracking and provides oversight of employee reception, appointment scheduling, time collection, records management, and inventory control.** **The Administrative Coordinator collaborates closely with managers and stakeholders across the University, including Human Resources (HR), Risk Management (RM), Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), and other departments. The position also serves as a liaison with external partners, including CorVel, which administers Workers’ Compensation (WC) claims.** **The Administrative Coordinator maintains a thorough understanding of the Clinical Services Associate administrative role and exemplifies the values of high-quality customer service in support of the mission and values of University Health Services (UHS). The incumbent serves as a role model for staff and provides supervision and guidance to administrative support personnel.**

Responsibilities:

**Administrative Management**

* Coordinates non-clinical case management tasks for workers’ compensation cases and workplace accommodation requests in collaboration with Risk Management, Human Resources, Environmental Health and Safety, CorVel, external vendors, and healthcare providers.

* Communicates with department managers and employees regarding their individual concerns/questions re: WC and disability matters while maintaining strict confidentiality and sensitivity to protected information.
* Manages the front desk operations for Occupational Health on a daily basis. Provides operational oversight to ensure sensitive and efficient patient reception, appointment scheduling, time management, time collection responsibilities and inventory management. This includes managing medical records for Occupational Health and oversight of an electronic medical record system as well as a hybrid chart to ensure that the system is organized, complete and meets the needs of the service.
* Is involved in troubleshooting and collecting data on a monthly basis to assist with overall strategic planning.
* Participates in hiring, training, assigning work, reviewing performance, recommending pay increases as well as participating in promotions and terminations for the Occupational Health Customer Service Representative, casual office support staff, and student workers.
* Provides Office Management of the examinations included in the medical surveillance programs, maintaining accurate data, scheduling appointments and assuring that the University is in compliance with OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) and state guidelines.

**Financial Management**

* Manages all departmental expenditures, collects data and prepares corresponding financial reports, for 3 project/grants with aggregate annual spending and income of approximately $61,000 and $14,000 respectively. Discretionary judgment is required for many purchases to ensure cost containment, value and availability of funds.

* Participates in UHS committees as assigned
* Contributes to departmental process improvement initiatives and supports organizational goals and strategic priorities.

**Performs other duties as assigned**

* High School Diploma
* Three to five years of experience in a busy medical practice
* Customer service training and aptitude
* Computer literacy including Microsoft Word and Excel
* Be comfortable in handling multiple tasks in a busy setting
* Flexibility/ability to accommodate the scheduling needs of the service.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree
* CPR certification
* Knowledge of Workers’ Compensation and Short Term Disability.
* Management supervisory skills
* Budget/bookkeeping skills
* Medical records and regulatory compliance knowledge.

### **Company Introduction:**

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

**Recruiting & HR Coordinator**
-------------------------------

Airspace is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Recruiting and HR Coordinator to help us scale during a period of significant hiring growth. In this role, you'll play a critical part in building our talent pipeline, from sourcing and coordinating candidates through the interview process to supporting their transition into the company, while also lending a hand across core HR operations. This is a fast-paced, hands-on role for someone who thrives on organization, momentum, and helping build great teams.

* Support full-cycle recruiting for a pipeline of open requisitions, from intake through offer, in partnership with the Senior Corporate Recruiter.
* Source active and passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, Greenhouse, and other sourcing tools.
* Conduct initial candidate outreach and support early-stage screening calls to confirm basic qualifications.
* Coordinate interview scheduling and logistics, ensuring a smooth and timely candidate experience.
* Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline status in the ATS.
* Assist with drafting and posting job requisitions.
* Support job offer preparation and extension in partnership with the Senior Corporate Recruiter and HR leadership.
* Help track and report on recruiting pipeline metrics.

### **HR Support (secondary focus)**

* Assist with onboarding related tasks: background checks, offer letters, and first-day coordination for new hires.
* Support New Hire Orientation sessions on a recurring basis.
* Help maintain accurate employee records in the HRIS system.
* Provide backup support for offboarding processes as needed.
* Assist with compliance tracking (e.g., state-mandated training completion) across jurisdictions.
* Partner cross-functionally with department leads to support broader HR needs as they arise.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 1–2+ years of experience in Human Resources or related administrative roles.
* Experience with HRIS systems (Rippling experience is a plus).
* Proficiency with G-Suite products.
* Familiarity with compliance and/or benefits administration.

ef248f9186a6bea11814.title: Project Coordinator
ef248f9186a6bea11814.description:
**Position Summary:**
=====================

  
National OnDemand is a telecommunications construction general contractor delivering fiber optic and outside plant (OSP) infrastructure programs nationwide. We are staffing a multi-year, large-scale project to install and test fiber optic and structured cabling infrastructure inside an AI data center campus in Louisiana. NATIONAL ONDEMAND is executing this scope as a construction partner to the general contractor leading the site program, and this role owns NATIONAL ONDEMAND's execution from mobilization through final acceptance and turnover.  
  
The Data Center Project Coordinator provides administrative, logistical, and deployment support for National OnDemand’s data center program. The position coordinates technician mobilization, travel, lodging, workforce schedules, training and compliance documentation, and daily administrative activities needed to support Corning project work. The role serves as a central coordination point among the Program Management Office, Project Management, Human Resources, Recruiting, Payroll, field leadership, technicians, and other internal partners.  
  
  

**Primary Position Duties:**
============================

* **Technician Deployment and Mobilization**
* Coordinate the deployment and mobilization of Data Center Technicians and Technician Leads to assigned project locations.
* Maintain current deployment rosters that identify employee assignments, positions, rotations, mobilization dates, shifts, and status.
* Confirm that employees complete required onboarding, training, documentation, and project-specific requirements before deployment.
* Track upcoming mobilizations, rotations, demobilizations, replacements, and staffing gaps, and communicate changes promptly to project leadership and affected employees.
* **Travel, Lodging, and Transportation Coordination**
* Coordinate employee travel arrangements associated with project deployment, training, scheduled rotations, and demobilization.
* Maintain lodging assignments, rooming lists, arrival and departure dates, and related changes.
* Coordinate transportation requirements with project leadership and communicate travel, lodging, and transportation instructions to employees before deployment.
* Escalate material travel or lodging issues to the appropriate leader and document resolution.
* **Scheduling and Workforce Tracking**
* Maintain technician rotation, shift, and deployment schedules and provide timely updates to Project Management.
* Track workforce availability and assist with replacements when employees are unavailable, reassigned, or removed from the project.
* Coordinate relevant schedule information with Human Resources and Payroll to support accurate employee records and timekeeping.
* Maintain current employee contact and emergency information for deployed personnel.
* **Training and Compliance Coordination**
* Track completion of required company, customer, site-specific, safety, technical, and data center training.
* Coordinate attendance for required training and maintain related training and certification records.
* Track background checks, drug screens, site access requirements, and other required deployment documentation.
* Notify appropriate leadership when an employee has not satisfied deployment or access requirements.
* **Administrative and Project Support**
* Maintain organized electronic project files, employee rosters, deployment trackers, and supporting documentation.
* Prepare and distribute staffing, deployment, training, lodging, and exception reports as requested.
* Support project meetings by preparing rosters, reports, meeting materials, and action-item trackers.
* Coordinate information among Project Management, Human Resources, Recruiting, Payroll, Safety, Operations, and field leadership.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support successful project execution.

**Position Requirements:**
==========================

* Experience coordinating employee travel, lodging, mobilization, or workforce deployment preferred.
* Strong organizational, written communication, problem-solving, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to prioritize changing business needs, maintain accuracy under time-sensitive conditions, and handle confidential employee and business information.
* Ability to communicate professionally with field employees, supervisors, managers, vendors, and corporate departments.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced project environment.

**Working conditions**

* Work is primarily performed in an office or remote administrative environment with frequent computer, telephone, email, and Microsoft Teams use.
* Occasional travel to project locations, training facilities, or workforce lodging sites may be required.
* Schedule flexibility, including occasional early morning, evening, or weekend availability, may be required during major deployments, rotation changes, or urgent project needs.

  
  
  
**Physical requirements**

* Ability to remain in a stationary position and work at a computer for extended periods.
* Ability to communicate and exchange accurate information by telephone, video conference, email, and in person.
* Ability to occasionally move or transport office materials weighing up to 20 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Education or Skills:**
========================

* High school diploma or GED required associate degree in business administration, project management, logistics, or a related field preferred.
* Two or more years of experience in administrative support, project coordination, logistics, dispatch, workforce scheduling, construction administration, or a related function.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, Outlook, Teams, and Word ability to maintain detailed trackers, schedules, and employee records.
* Experience supporting construction, telecommunications, fiber, data center, or infrastructure projects preferred.

064231851510c272137f.title: Referral Administrative Coordinator - Shreiber School of Veterinary Medicine
064231851510c272137f.description:
**Job no:** 501964  
**Work type:** Regular Full-Time  
**Location:** Glassboro, New Jersey  
**Categories:** School of Veterinary Medicine

**Referral Administrative Coordinator - Shreiber School of Veterinary Medicine**

**(Administrative Coordinator II)**

**Work type:** Regular Full-Time  
**Location:** Glassboro, New Jersey  
**Categories:** School of Veterinary Medicine

  

**Our Mission:**

Our top priorities are the development of an institution delivering excellent client and patient care in addition to training graduates who are competent, confident, and ready for practice from day one. Our goal is to do this through establishing a collaborative, education-and-culture-focused school that fosters continuity through the patient, client, student, faculty and employee journeys.

  

**Position Summary:**

The Shreiber School of Veterinary Medicine of Rowan University (SSVM) is seeking a Referral Coordinator to join its new veterinary program and teaching hospital. The hospital is located 1.5 miles from the main Glassboro campus.

The Veterinary Teaching Hospital is a new and innovative medical facility for small animals, equipped with state-of-the-art equipment. The teaching hospital is designed to accommodate multiple specialty departments, including anesthesia, cardiology, dentistry and oral surgery, diagnostic imaging, emergency/critical care, exotics, neurology, ophthalmology, primary care, and surgery.

This position will support the Public Relations & Communications team.

The Referral Coordinator serves as a liaison between the Veterinary Teaching Hospital and referring veterinarians in the surrounding region. The Referral Coordinator will be a key communications representative supporting the growth of specialty services. They will possess knowledge of the regional veterinary landscape and strategically manage referral DVM (rDVM) and team relationships. This role manages the relationships and reputation of all specialty departments of the hospital with the referring veterinary community. In addition, they are responsible for multi-modal marketing for the entire hospital including other assigned service lines or strategic focus areas. The Referral Coordinator collaborates with other employees in the hospital and ensures efficient processes as they pertain to referrals.

  

**Our Ideal Candidate:**

* Is self-motivated
* Has strong communication, organizational, and customer service skills
* Has excellent EQ, maturity and interpersonal skills
* Demonstrates a commitment to a collaborative and collegial work culture
* Problem-solves and adapts to a fast-growing and changing environment with a growth mindset

  

**Job Duties Include but are not Limited To:**

* Build relationships with referring veterinarians
* Work with all hospital departments collaboratively to acquire extensive knowledge of clinical services and articulate in an engaging manner to represent hospital
* Conduct regular outreach calls, emails and visits to rDVMs
* Develop and maintain a referral management database
* Work closely with the CSR department, specialty doctors and technicians while keeping an open dialogue and direct communication
* Discover, document and relay interesting patient stories, milestones and newsworthy moments that happen in the teaching hospital to the Director of Public Relations & Communications
* Demonstrate excellent customer service and EQ when speaking to clients, veterinarians, and all members of the referring hospital team
* Actively monitor specialty doctor schedules as well as offerings and schedules at regional referral centers
* In conjunction with hospital leadership, track, respond and resolve issues and concerns from referring DVMs and clients through all mediums including online
* Identify and help craft professional and timely responses to client complaints and negative reviews online
* Document and track interactions with referring vets
* Assure that the Veterinary Teaching Hospital message is received by and resonates with rDVMs
* Plan and organize CE events hosted by hospital including speaker lineup and scheduling, RACE-approval, and room reservation and catering
* Plan for and attend the state Veterinary Conference and any other veterinary meetings in New Jersey, as well as participate in community events
* Complete all assigned tasks in a timely manner

  

**Job Summary:**

* Able to thrive in a growing business environment with an ability to creatively address problems head on
* Comfortable in a fast paced, dynamic environment
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple priorities
* Exceptional attention to detail, follow–through and organizational skills
* Clear and concise communication skills
* Develop professional relationships with referring veterinarians
* Develop standard operating procedures for communicating with rDVMs, running continuing education events, and follow the prescribed steps
* Provide support to other departments and projects as needed while being able to assess and prioritize needs
* Facilitate continuing education events and man tables at veterinary conferences or other School-related events
* Work with the Director of Development to gain sponsorship of the School’s continuing education program

  

**Reporting Structure:**

The Referral Coordinator will report directly to the Director of Public Relations & Communications.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Extremely organized
* Previous experience with Microsoft including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.
* Flexible schedule (some evenings and weekends)
* Driver’s License and reliable form of transportation

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience working in veterinary medicine in a multi-specialty practice

  

**Salary & Benefit Information:**

In compliance with The State of New Jersey's Pay Transparency Act, the annual base salary range for this position is $55,000 to $60,000. When extending any salary offer, Rowan University considers many factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, work experience, education, training, key skills, internal equity, as well as market and other organizational considerations.

For eligible employees, benefits include: comprehensive NJ State health, dental and retirement benefits, extensive accrued time off/paid holidays, and tuition reimbursement for employee, spouse, and dependents to attend Rowan University, Glassboro. (Tuition reimbursement will apply to undergraduate degrees only for spouse and dependents).

For more detailed information, please visit: https://sites.rowan.edu/hr/benefits/

**Working Conditions:**

***Hazards***

* Veterinary workers may be exposed to hazards like slips, trips, and falls. They may also be exposed to unpleasant odors, noises, and animal feces and urine. When working around animals that are frightened or in pain, employees risk being bitten, kicked, or scratched.
* Employees may be exposed to hazards like bloodborne pathogens, hazardous drugs, radiation, toxic waste, and chemical hazards such as disinfectants, pesticides, and latex.

***Animals***

* The types of animals treated at a veterinary hospital can affect the working conditions. Our teaching hospital may consist, but is not limited to, the following types of animals: small mammals, large mammals, livestock, reptiles, avians, and other exotic animals.

**Information about the Institution:**

A top 100 national public research institution, Rowan University offers bachelor’s through doctoral and professional programs in person and online to nearly 25,000 students. The fastest-growing public research institution in the Northeast and among the country’s top 10 fastest-growing, Rowan offers a thriving multidisciplinary environment with a strong emphasis on practical research in health care, engineering, science and business, while ensuring excellence in undergraduate education. Nationally recognized for innovation, high-quality, affordable education and public-private partnerships, Rowan is one of two universities in the U.S. to offer M.D., D.O. and D.V.M. degree programs.

  

The Shreiber School of Veterinary Medicine is located on the Glassboro, New Jersey west campus, 22 miles southeast of Philadelphia. The Shreiber School of Veterinary Medicine's first class of DVM students were admitted in September 2025. Facilities include a 167,000 square foot building that is shared as an academic teaching facility aimed at the delivery of pre-clinical training, a small animal teaching hospital, and a research facility.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ethnicity, race, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, national origin, (dis)ability status, military status, and other NJ protected classes. Rowan University does not discriminate on the basis of sex in its educational programs and activities, including employment as required by Title IX. Rowan is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with (dis)abilities.

As a state public University, Rowan employees are eligible to participate in the federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness program. More information on this program is available at https://studentaid.gov/manage-loans/forgiveness-cancellation/public-service.

**Notes:**

* The job posting will remain active until all positions are filled.
* Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US, and the university will not sponsor an applicant for a work visa for this position.

**Advertised:** Nov 25 2026 Eastern Standard Time  
**Applications close:** Feb 22 2027 11:55 PM Eastern Standard Time

We’re Empower Physical Therapy, a self-pay private practice in Brooklyn, and we’re looking for a remote Administrative Assistant to join our team. You can work from anywhere in the US.

Most of our clients come to us after getting frustrated with traditional physical therapy clinics. They want care that’s built around them, and that’s what we do. Our physical therapists help people feel better through hands-on manual therapy, education, movement, and lifestyle changes. We offer pelvic floor physical therapy, orthopedic physical therapy, and remote fitness programming.

Our space is warm and welcoming, but it’s also built to help clients develop real physical resilience, which is why we have a full gym on site. We want our clients to find ease in their bodies and also feel confident they can take on whatever life asks of them, whether that’s parenting, hiking, running, lifting at the gym, or performing on the stage or the court.

You’ll be the first person our prospective clients talk to, and that matters more than you might think. Research shows that a patient’s experience with the front office affects how confident they feel about their own recovery. In other words, you have the chance to help people feel better before they ever meet one of our physical therapists.

We’re a small, close-knit team. You’ll work directly with me and our therapists, so we need someone who:

* Is organized and has a strong eye for detail
* Spots what needs doing and takes care of it without being asked
* Brings energy and a positive attitude to the team

Experience in administration, sales, or customer service at a small business is a plus. Most of all, we’re looking for someone motivated who wants to grow with us

Lead generation and conversion

* Ads: Google Business Suite
* Voip: Quo
* Google Workspace: Proficient in GMail, Docs, Sheets, Spaces, Tasks

Calendar management

* Responding to patient requests for superbills or other faxed documentation requests for insurance submissions

Coordinating Marketing Meetings

2af3b52a25a951a3706d.title: Technical Support Specialist (Tier 1)
2af3b52a25a951a3706d.description:
**About MaidCentral**

MaidCentral is a cloud-based field service platform built for the residential cleaning industry. We help cleaning businesses scale their operations and increase profitability by bringing everything they need to run the business into one system: scheduling, dispatch, payroll, payments, marketing, sales, process management, quality management, reporting, and much more.

We call our customers **Partners**, because their success is our success. We are growing quickly and building a best-in-class team. If you want to solve real problems, be an integral part of a team, and grow with a fast-moving vertical SaaS company, we would love to meet you.

Everything we do is measured against **The MaidCentral Standard**:

*Create raving fans by delivering rock-solid reliability on time, in a short time, the first time, every time.*

**Position Overview**

The Technical Support Specialist is the first line of help for MaidCentral Partners. You will answer questions and troubleshoot issues across our web platform and mobile apps through our ticketing system, email, live chat, phone, and video calls.

This is an entry-level role and a great way to start a career in SaaS. We will train you on the product and the cleaning industry. What we are looking for is someone who is comfortable with technology, enjoys solving puzzles, and genuinely cares about helping people. You take ownership of every issue and see it through until the Partner is back to running their business.

**Responsibilities**

* Respond to Partner tickets, live chats, emails, and calls promptly and professionally, within our service-level targets.
* Take ownership of each issue and see it through to resolution, keeping the Partner informed along the way.
* Research, diagnose, and troubleshoot issues with the web platform, mobile apps (iOS and Android), devices, and integrations such as QuickBooks Online, payments, and text and email messaging.
* Walk Partners through workflows step by step, including scheduling, dispatch, payroll, and reporting.
* Reproduce and document bugs clearly, and escalate complex issues to Tier 2 support or Engineering with the details they need to act quickly.
* Keep complete, accurate records of every interaction in our ticketing system. **Spot trends in Partner questions and share ideas that improve the product, our processes, and the Partner experience.**
* Create and update knowledge base articles and how-to guides so Partners can help themselves. **Partner with Implementation and Partner Success on hand-offs and Partners who need extra attention.**
* Uphold MaidCentral's service standards and contribute to a positive, collaborative team. **Other duties as assigned.**

**How Success Is Measured**

* First response and resolution times
* First-contact resolution rate
* Partner satisfaction (CSAT) on your tickets

Overview:

The Client Service Representative (CSR) provides high quality customer service to internal and external customers, including the students. As the "face" of UHS, the Client Services Representative is tasked with providing service in a welcoming and professional manner, in keeping with the established mission and values of UHS.

This is a full-time, benefits-eligible position with an annual salary range of $56,000 - $63,000 ($29.70 - $33.42/hourly).

Responsibilities:

**Client Service**

* Provides high quality client service to students and patients consistent with UHS standards.
* Greets the patients and documents their arrival for appointments and urgent care services; provide directions to their designated waiting area.
* Responds to patients’ concerns and emotional state professionally and appropriately, especially when students presenting are ill.
* Maintains a professional demeanor despite the volume of presenting patients and multiple competing demands in a very busy practice setting.
* Listens carefully to students’ concerns, helping them determine the best appointment options for them, making appropriate decisions regarding which practitioner and time frame is best suited for that particular concern and correctly documenting and acting on this information.
* Exhibits superior communication skills and professionalism in order to provide a safe and confidential interaction with the students recognizing that this is a high priority in this sensitive and specialized area.
* Responds timely to patients’ questions or concerns (issues regarding insurance, their bills, appointment rescheduling, referrals, etc.) If unable to answer a question, the CSR will direct the patient to someone who can, and stays on the line or with the patient until it is certain they have received a response to their inquiry.
* Uses service recovery techniques and principles when a customer is dissatisfied.

**Administrative Support**

* Utilizes Medicat (UHS’ practice management system) for all workflow, including electronic health records (EHR) management, financial transactions, data reporting, and scheduling. Follows standard operating procedures regarding scheduling guidelines; reviews the practitioner’s notes, outside specialist referrals, and completed laboratory and radiology results, and provides printed documentation when necessary.
* Schedules immunization appointments, based on a thorough knowledge of immunization sequencing.
* Scans medical documents as required by the paperless charting system (radiology and laboratory results, as well as outside consultations and test results).
* Performs data entry of medical information for all incoming and returning students.
* Under the direction of the Lead Client Services Representative, releases highly sensitive and confidential private medical information to students, outside agencies, legal institutions, including subpoenas in accordance with state and federal laws and UHS risk management policies.
* Assists with arrangements for transportation for patients going to University Medical Center at Princeton or referred to a community physician.
* Rotates through other UHS areas in a support role when needed.
* Becomes cross trained with all the duties of the front desk.
* Assumes additional duties as assigned by the Office Manager.

**Financial Support**

* Perform cashiering and billing functions for the sale of billable products.

**Clinical Care**

* Responds to the emergency respond call system, notifying medical personnel, and providing additional assistance as needed such as calling 911, holding the elevator and directing arriving emergency responders. When needed, initiates care at the front desk to students who are vomiting, fainting, or exhibiting open wounds, etc. while waiting for UHS medical providers.

**Strategic Initiatives**

* Contributes to UHS process improvement plan and when possible, represents Outpatient Services on job appropriate committees.

**Performs other duties as assigned.**

Qualifications:

**Essential Qualifications**

* High school diploma or GED
* 2-3 years of experience in a customer service position.
* Ability to work weekends and to accommodate changes in work schedules.
* Knowledge of Medicat
* Be knowledgeable in principles and methodologies (e.g., Plan-Do-Study-Act, Root Cause Analysis, measurement, data collection, and analysis) needed to support and lead Quality Improvement projects and activities and/or willing to attend UHS-based Quality Improvement basic training within first 6-months of hire.
* Respects the cultures and identities of others.
* Demonstrates curiosity and open mindset regarding those of different identities and cultures.
* Demonstrates a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.

Preferred Qualifications

* Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) or Medical Assistant (CMA) Certification
* Cardio Pulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) certification
* 1 – 2 years of experience in an ambulatory health care office
* Familiarity with total work systems (such as the Institute for Healthcare Improvement, Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care, and Baldrige National Quality Program); and reviewing and analyzing data.
* Training in health equity and other diversity and inclusion topics.
